title: Tag Manager Pixel Tracking Specialist – Pixels, Events & Attribution
description:
We’re Not Hiring a Tag Installer. We’re Hiring a Signal Guardian.

(PLEASE DO NOT REPLY DIRECTLY TO THIS POST. IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO APPLY, FOLLOW THE STEPS AT THE END.)



Pay: Negotiable flat rate per 2-week period (USD), based on experience

Pay Timing: Paid once every 2 weeks. 80 hours per period, agreed upon at hire

Location: Remote (Philippines-based applicants only)

Role Type: Full-time | Long-term

Team Scope: Owns tracking integrity across accounts and platforms



Why This Role Exists

Ads don’t fail when creative is bad.

They fail when signals lie.



At Black Hat Strategy, we operate in restricted and volatile advertising environments where performance decisions are only as good as the data behind them. When tracking breaks, buyers react to ghosts. Budgets get pulled. Escalations happen for the wrong reasons.



We’re hiring a Tracking Specialist to ensure that what we see is real, what fires is accurate, and what we optimize against can be trusted.



This role exists so:

Media Buyers aren’t guessing

Escalation teams aren’t chasing false alarms

Leadership isn’t making decisions on bad data

This is not about “installing a pixel once.”

This is about ongoing signal integrity.



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

You won’t be running ads.

You’ll be protecting the data behind them.



As a Tracking Specialist, you will:

Set up and validate tracking across ecommerce platforms

 (Shopify, custom sites, and other CMS environments)

Configure and audit:

Meta Pixel

Conversion API (CAPI)

Event prioritization & AEM

Deduplication logic



Use tools like:

Meta Events Manager

Google Tag Manager

Platform diagnostics

Verify that events fire correctly across:

Browsers

Devices

Consent states

Document setups, issues, and fixes clearly inside ClickUp

Support Escalation & Recovery by validating whether issues are technical or behavioral



You are not reacting to noise.

You are confirming truth.



What This Role Owns (From the SOP)

Tracking setup and validation

Ongoing signal health monitoring

Technical audits during escalations

Confirmation that performance drops are real

Documentation of tracking logic and changes



If tracking is wrong, this role finds it.

If tracking is right, this role proves it.



This Role Is for Someone Who…

Has hands-on experience with:

Meta Pixel & Events Manager

CAPI

Google Tag Manager

Has a web development or technical background

 (HTML, JavaScript, data layers, CMS platforms)

Understands how tracking behaves across browsers and devices

Thinks in root causes, not surface symptoms

Documents work cleanly and precisely

Enjoys deep, technical problem-solving

This role rewards people who value accuracy while maintaining speed.



This Role Is Not for Someone Who…

Only knows “copy/paste” pixel setups

Avoids technical debugging

Gets frustrated digging through logs or diagnostics

Wants creative or strategic ownership

Dislikes documentation



How You’ll Work With the Team

Media Buyers execute campaigns… you ensure their signals are real

Escalation & Recovery Lead investigates issues… you validate the data layer

Project Manager ensures flow… you keep tracking work visible and documented

Ops Head sets standards… you enforce technical integrity



You are not creating performance.

You are protecting it.



Why You’ll Like Working Here

Deep technical ownership

Respect for careful, precise work

Clear systems and SOPs

No guesswork, no chaos

Long-term role with real importance



We don’t reward speed for speed’s sake.

We reward correctness.



Application Process

PLEASE DO NOT JUST REPLY TO THIS POST ON THE JOB BOARD.

To be considered, you must complete ALL STEPS BELOW.

The Google Form is your Online Interview.



Step 1: Take a short online IQ test

We respect intelligence and we think you probably do too.

Go to the Fast Learner Free IQ Test and complete it

Create a free account at the end

Save the results URL for Step 3

?? Applicants without a valid link will not be considered



Step 2: Record a 2–3 minute Loom video (camera ON)

Create a free account at Loom

Speak clearly in English

Tell us:

Your paid media experience

How you think about optimization and ROAS

How you’ve helped others improve performance

Save the Loom URL for Step 3



Step 3: Complete the Online Interview

NO AI ALLOWED. We want to hear you.

Open the Application Form

Enter your contact details

Paste:

IQ test results link

Loom video link

Answer all questions honestly and thoughtfully

Your answers matter more than perfect formatting.



Step 4: Live Video Interview (camera on)

This is where we get to know how you think.

I personally review every candidate who completes the steps above and will reach out directly to those who feel like the right fit.



If this role speaks to you, good.

That means you’re probably the kind of person we’re looking for.

Bring your best.

We’ll bring the system.

We’re looking for an experienced direct-response video editor who can create high-converting
/Meta video ads using AI talking-head footage, VSL-style editing, B-roll, captions, graphics, sound design, and strong pacing.



This is NOT a beginner editing position.



Editing Style We Want



Your work should be similar to these examples:















The typical videos will be:



AI spokesperson / talking-head videos

Direct-response
 ads

Mini VSLs

Usually under 20 minutes

Fast-paced editing designed to HOLD ATTENTION and SELL, not just look pretty

You MUST Have Experience With:

HeyGen

Higgsfield AI

AI avatars / AI spokesperson videos

Direct-response
/Meta ads

VSL editing

Finding and using relevant B-roll

Captions and on-screen text

Pattern interrupts

Sound effects and music

Strong hooks and pacing

Making AI footage feel natural instead of obviously AI-generated



You should also have a good understanding of direct-response advertising.



I don't just need someone who knows Premiere Pro or CapCut.



You need to understand things like:



Hook → problem → curiosity → mechanism → proof → solution → CTA



You should know WHY certain cuts, visuals, captions, B-roll and pattern interrupts are being used.



IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING



I will NOT respond to applications without relevant examples.



When applying, send me 2–5 examples of VSL / direct-response
 ads you personally edited that are as close as possible to the examples above.



Do NOT send:



Gaming edits

YouTube vlogs

Wedding videos

Random TikToks

Basic talking-head podcast clips

A huge portfolio where I have to search for relevant work



Send me the most similar ads you have edited.



If you have worked with supplement, health, ecommerce or DTC brands, mention that.



English



You need to be able to communicate well in English and understand English scripts properly.



A major part of this job is understanding what the script is saying so you can choose the correct visuals, B-roll, captions and emotional pacing.



What I'm Looking For



I want someone who:



Has real experience, not someone learning on the job

Can follow reference ads closely

Understands direct-response marketing

Has good creative judgment

Can work independently

Notices small mistakes before submitting

Can take feedback and make revisions quickly

Is reliable and communicates clearly

Can consistently produce multiple creatives, not disappear after one video



This can become consistent long-term work for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word “VSL” so I know you actually read the post.



Then send:



Your 3 best relevant VSL/Facebook ad examples

Which tools you use for editing

Your experience with HeyGen

Your experience with Higgsfield

Any ecommerce / supplement / DTC brands you've edited for

Roughly how long it takes you to edit a 5–10 minute VSL

Your rate per video or preferred working arrangement



If you don't send relevant examples, I will not respond.



I'm specifically looking for someone who has already produced ads similar to the references above — not someone who thinks they could learn how to do it.

title: Email Marketing Specialist
description:
Email & Lifecycle Marketing Specialist

Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Reports to: Head of Marketing

Compensation: Based on experience



About Hē Labs

Hē Labs makes performance supplements for men — SLEEP, BRAIN, PERFORM, and UNWIND — built on the premise that sleep is the foundation everything else is built on.

With 60,000+ customers across Europe and strong repeat purchase behavior, we are now expanding a proven product line into the U.S. across Amazon, DTC subscription, and paid media.



The Role

You will own the lifecycle marketing function end to end — from capture and nurture to conversion, retention, and win-back.

 and SMS are your primary channels, and you will be accountable for their contribution to revenue.

This is a specialist role. You will:

Build and manage the funnel architecture

Develop and optimize lifecycle campaigns and automations

Run a structured testing program

Improve conversion and retention as the U.S. business scales

Monitor performance and identify opportunities for revenue growth

Success means building a lifecycle program that compounds — where each customer cohort performs better than the previous one.

We use the StoryBrand framework, where the customer is the hero and Hē Labs is the guide. Every touchpoint should provide customers with a clear plan and call to action.

You will also own the copy. Every
 and SMS message will be written by you, including subject lines, body copy, offers, and calls to action.

You will work closely with our Senior Graphic Designer, who owns the visual direction and design execution. You own the messaging and copy.



What You'll Own

1. List Growth & Lead Capture

On-site capture across Shopify, including:

Pop-ups

Embedded forms

Quizzes

Exit-intent campaigns

Incentive mechanics

Mobile-first placements

Offer architecture — determining what we exchange for an
 versus a phone number and understanding the margin implications

Landing pages and lead magnets designed specifically for paid traffic

Evaluation, implementation, and performance assessment of anonymous visitor identification and enrichment tools

Amazon-to-DTC and packaging-insert capture paths



2. Flows & Automation

Build, maintain, and optimize lifecycle flows including:

Welcome and education series that establish the sleep-first thesis before conversion

Abandoned cart

Abandoned checkout

Browse abandonment

Price-drop alerts

Back-in-stock triggers

Post-purchase onboarding

Replenishment timing

Cross-sell campaigns across the four SKUs

Subscription lifecycle:

Pre-billing notifications

Failed payment recovery

Pause-in-lieu-of-cancel

Reactivation

Win-back and lapsed-customer sequences segmented by product and churn reason



3. Copy & Messaging

You will be responsible for writing:

 copy

SMS copy

Subject lines

Preview text

Offers

Calls to action

Landing page copy

Lead magnet copy for paid traffic

You will also own:

Message hierarchy

Creative briefs for the Senior Graphic Designer

Consistent brand voice

Consistent StoryBrand structure across all lifecycle touchpoints



4. Campaigns & Experimentation

Manage the promotional calendar and campaign cadence across
 and SMS

Develop and maintain a continuous, documented testing program

Test:

Offers

Subject lines

Send timing

SMS cadence

Flow entry logic

Split paths

Maintain a prioritized testing backlog

Develop segmentation and RFM modeling

Maintain suppression discipline to protect list health

Monitor deliverability, including:

Domain warming

Authentication

List hygiene

Sender reputation

Inbox placement



5. Compliance & Reporting

Manage consent capture and record-keeping across U.S. and EU markets

Understand and follow:

TCPA

CAN-SPAM

GDPR

ePrivacy requirements

Provide weekly and monthly reporting against channel revenue targets

Use Triple Whale for attribution and performance analysis



Our Tech Stack

Klaviyo | GoHighLevel | Shopify | Triple Whale

You should be highly proficient in Klaviyo and GoHighLevel, with the ability to build, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize within both platforms.



Your First 90 Days

First 30 Days

Complete an audit of existing flows, capture points, list health, and deliverability

Establish baselines for all core metrics

First 60 Days

Rebuild and launch core flows, including:

Welcome

Cart abandonment

Checkout abandonment

Post-purchase

Dunning

Implement and launch Shopify capture improvements

First 90 Days

Establish a consistent testing program

Implement the segmentation model

Document the key revenue-driving levers for the brand

Establish a clear framework for ongoing optimization



What You Bring

Required

4+ years of experience owning
 and SMS for a DTC e-commerce brand, ideally subscription-based

Proven experience managing revenue performance, not just send volume

Ability to explain
 and SMS contribution to total revenue and how you have improved it

Advanced experience with Klaviyo, GoHighLevel, and Shopify

Demonstrated expertise in deliverability, including experience resolving sender reputation issues

Ability to edit Shopify themes directly or work effectively with developers to implement capture improvements quickly

Fluency in the StoryBrand methodology and demonstrated ability to apply it across funnels,
s, and landing pages

Strong direct-response copywriting skills

Ability to independently write
s, SMS, and landing page copy in a brand voice

Working knowledge of consent and compliance requirements in both U.S. and EU markets



Preferred

Experience in supplements, wellness, or another regulated-claims category

Experience with Triple Whale or comparable attribution platforms

Experience implementing identity resolution and visitor identification tools

Experience working with external paid media and creative agencies



How We Measure Success

Your performance will be measured through key business and lifecycle metrics, including:

 and SMS as a percentage of total DTC revenue

 and SMS capture rate against site traffic

Flow revenue per recipient, by flow

Subscription retention

Churn rate

Dunning recovery rate

Net list growth after churn and suppression

Inbox placement and overall deliverability health

Testing velocity and win rate



Why This Role?

You’ll be joining a brand with a proven product, an established customer base, and a U.S. launch backed by real investment.

The lifecycle program will be yours to build, own, optimize, and scale — with its impact directly visible in the company's revenue and P&L.

title: **Sales, Brand Growth & Business Development VA**
description:
**Sales, Brand Growth & Business Development 



**Status Plus Mindset | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity**



Status Plus is looking for a **highly skilled Virtual Assistant with a proven background in sales, business development, social media outreach, and customer acquisition.**



This is **NOT a basic VA, data-entry, or administrative position.**



We need someone who can learn the Status Plus brand, understand our mission and message, identify revenue opportunities, find the right customers and organizations, and confidently represent and sell what we offer.



## ABOUT STATUS PLUS



Status Plus is more than one product. It is a mindset, personal-development brand, and growing business ecosystem built around the message:



**“Even on your worst day, your Status is Plus.”**



Our revenue opportunities include:



* Status Plus Mindset Course & 15-Day Challenge

* Status Plus books

* Status Plus clothing and merchandise

* Speaking engagements

* Corporate and organizational opportunities

* Workshops and group programs

* Community memberships and programs

* Brand partnerships and collaborations

* Bulk book and merchandise sales

* Schools, nonprofits, businesses, churches, community organizations and other potential partners

* Future Status Plus products, events and programs



## WHAT WE NEED



We are looking for someone who understands **SALES**.



You should be able to take our brand, products and story and determine:



**Who needs this?

Where can we find them?

How do we reach them?

How do we get their attention?

How do we turn that conversation into revenue?**



You will research and identify potential customers, organizations, partners and opportunities and conduct professional outreach through:



* Instagram

*

* LinkedIn

* TikTok

* YouTube

*

* Direct messaging

* Online communities

* Business directories

* Media outlets

* Podcasts

* Speaking platforms

* Corporate contacts

* Schools and organizations

* Influencers and brand partners

* Other relevant sales and marketing channels



You should also be able to recognize **new revenue opportunities that we may not currently be pursuing.**



## RESPONSIBILITIES



You will help:



* Develop and execute sales/outreach strategies

* Generate qualified leads

* Build targeted prospect lists

* Conduct daily outreach

* Follow up consistently with prospects

* Sell courses, books, clothing and other Status Plus products

* Find speaking engagement opportunities

* Identify podcast, media and interview opportunities

* Find corporate, school and organizational partnerships

* Pursue bulk book/course opportunities

* Develop potential brand collaborations

* Convert social media followers into customers

* Re-engage interested prospects who have not purchased

* Help build sales funnels and customer follow-up strategies

* Track leads, conversations, follow-ups and results

* Provide weekly reports showing activity, leads, opportunities and sales

* Recommend new ways Status Plus can generate revenue



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The right person should have a **proven track record in sales and customer acquisition.**



You should have experience with:



* Sales

* Lead generation

* Business development

* Social selling

* Social media outreach

*
 outreach

* Prospecting

* Closing or assisting with closing sales

* CRM systems

* Lead follow-up

* Partnership development

* Online research

* Building sales pipelines



Experience working with **personal-development brands, coaches, authors, speakers, online courses, apparel brands or entrepreneurs** is a major plus.



## IMPORTANT



We are **not looking for someone who simply posts content and waits for customers to appear.**



We want someone proactive who knows how to **go find business.**



You should be comfortable researching prospects, starting conversations, following up, presenting offers, overcoming objections and moving opportunities toward a sale.



## WHEN APPLYING



Please answer the following:



1. Tell us about your sales experience.

2. What have you personally sold?

3. How did you find customers?

4. What were your measurable results?

5. What social media platforms have you used for lead generation and sales?

6. What CRM and sales tools have you used?

7. Have you sold courses, books, apparel, coaching, speaking services or similar products?

8. Give an example of a sales campaign or outreach strategy you personally executed.

9. How would you find speaking engagements for the founder of Status Plus?

10. How would you generate customers for the Status Plus Mindset Course?

11. What would you do during your first 30 days working with Status Plus?



**Please provide proof, examples, numbers or references supporting your sales experience whenever possible.**



Generic applications will not be considered.



## THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone who can grow with Status Plus long-term.



This position can develop into a much larger **Sales & Business Development role** for the right person who demonstrates the ability to consistently generate leads, opportunities, partnerships and revenue.



**Our goal is simple: build the Status Plus brand, reach more people, create meaningful opportunities, and turn those opportunities into sustainable revenue.**





**base hourly rate + performance commission/bonuses**

title: We Need One Great Support Person (Shopify + Subscriptions, US Brand, Long Term)
description:
Read this part first



Most support jobs are ticket jobs. You clear the queue, you hit a response time target, nobody notices you unless something goes wrong.



This is not that.



We sell consumer health products in the US on a monthly subscription. That means every single customer conversation is worth real money over time. A customer you calm down and keep stays with us for months. A customer you lose with a lazy reply costs us their entire lifetime value. Support is not a cost center in this business, it is where retention is won or lost.



So we are hiring one person and paying them properly, instead of three people cheaply.



We keep our brand name out of the public posting for competitive reasons. You get the full picture (brand, product, revenue, how we operate) on the intro call, and we will sign an NDA if you want one.



A normal day



You open the inbox. Overnight there are 40 to 70 messages from American customers. Some are simple: where is my order, can I change my address. Some are not: a failed payment on a subscription, someone who wants to cancel because they "did not see results yet", someone whose package says delivered but is not there, someone asking whether the product is safe alongside another supplement.



You work through all of it. You handle the subscription changes yourself in Loop. You issue the refund in Shopify when it is the right call, and you find a better solution when it is not. You notice that eleven people this week asked the same confusing question, and you tell us, because that is a landing page problem, not a support problem.



By the end of your day the queue is empty and nothing has been left for tomorrow.



The tools you will live in



Shopify, Loop Subscriptions, and a helpdesk (Gorgias or similar). If you have used Recharge, Skio or Bold instead of Loop, that transfers fine. If you have never touched a subscription tool, this role will be a hard climb.



This job is for you if



Your written English is genuinely native-level. Our customers are American and they will notice the difference. We test this before anything else.

You have supported ecommerce brands before and can name them

You can be trusted with a refund decision without asking permission every time

You would rather own one brand deeply than juggle five clients

You want a job you are still doing in two years, with more responsibility and more money each year



This job is not for you if



You are looking for something part time on the side

You need to be reminded and followed up on

Your plan is to use canned replies for everything

You cannot overlap with US business hours at all



Nice to have, not required



German (we run other brands in Europe and we pay extra for it)

Health, supplement or wellness niche experience

Experience writing SOPs or macro libraries from scratch



The money



$1,000 to $1,400 per month, depending on what you bring. That is above the usual range for this role and we know it. We would rather overpay one excellent person than manage three average ones.

title: Support Specialist, $1,000-$1,400/mo, One Brand, Two Year Horizon
description:
US direct-to-consumer health brand. Monthly subscription model. Shopify plus Loop. American customers. Growing fast.



We need one support person to own the entire customer inbox. Not a team, not a pool of freelancers. One person, paid well, staying for years.



Brand name comes on the call. NDA available if you want one.



What you own



The inbox. All of it. Emails, subscription changes, refunds, guarantee claims, chargeback documentation, and the weekly summary of what customers keep complaining about.



Nobody will check your queue for you. That is the point of hiring someone good.



How we will measure you



We are telling you this upfront so there are no surprises in month three:



First response under 12 hours, every ticket, no exceptions

Queue at zero before you log off

CSAT above 4.7

Subscription save rate on cancellation requests, we will set the target together after your first month

Weekly issue report, every Friday, unprompted



Hit those and you get raises, bonuses, and more responsibility. Miss them consistently and we part ways quickly and politely. We are direct about this because most support hires fail on expectations that were never stated.



Hard requirements



Native-level written English. Not conversational, not "very good". Our customers are American consumers and the gap is obvious to them. This is the first thing we test.

Ecommerce support experience, with brands you can name

Shopify: orders, refunds, fulfillment, customer records

Overlap with US business hours

Reliable connection, quiet space, no second full-time job



Strong advantages



Subscription tools: Loop, Recharge, Skio, Bold

Helpdesk: Gorgias, Zendesk, Help Scout, Richpanel, Freshdesk

German (we run brands in Europe and pay a premium for it)

Supplement or wellness niche



What you get



$1,000 to $1,400 per month based on experience. Above market, deliberately.



And a job that is still yours in two years if you want it.

title: QuickBooks Bookkeeper / Virtual Assistant for Cabin Construction Company
description:
We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented virtual assistant with strong QuickBooks Online experience to manage the bookkeeping and financial records for our cabin construction company.



This is not only a data-entry position. We need someone who understands construction bookkeeping, job costing, inventory, reimbursements, and tracking the profitability of individual cabin builds.



Responsibilities:



Maintain and update QuickBooks Online

Create a separate project for every cabin build

Record materials, labor, subcontractors, deposits, sales, and other expenses

Track the estimated cost versus actual cost of each cabin

Track payments made from company accounts

Track money paid personally by owners that must be reimbursed

Track unpaid bills and remaining construction costs

Maintain detailed inventory records for materials and supplies

Separate current-build expenses from materials purchased for future builds

Upload and organize receipts, invoices, contracts, and payment records

Reconcile bank accounts and credit cards monthly

Track customer deposits, balances due, sales tax, and completed sales

Produce easy-to-understand weekly reports showing:

Cost of each cabin

Amount paid

Amount still owed

Reimbursements due

Inventory on hand

Expected profit

Final profit after the cabin is sold

Maintain a clear Google Sheets tracking system that matches QuickBooks

Identify duplicate, missing, or incorrectly classified transactions

Keep all financial information current, accurate, and organized



Required qualifications:



Strong experience with QuickBooks Online

Experience with construction bookkeeping or job-cost accounting

Excellent knowledge of Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel

Experience tracking inventory, materials, and subcontractor expenses

Strong attention to detail

Good written English and communication skills

Ability to work independently and ask questions when information is unclear

Ability to handle confidential financial information

Availability for some working-hour overlap with Pennsylvania, USA



This will begin as a part-time position and may grow as the company expands. We are looking for someone dependable who wants a long-term working relationship.



To apply, please send:



A summary of your QuickBooks Online experience

Details about your construction or job-cost bookkeeping experience

An example of a report or tracking system you have created

Your hourly or monthly rate

Your weekly availability and time zone

Two professional references

Your answer to this question: How would you record an expense paid personally by an owner for Cabin #2 that the company must reimburse later?



Please begin your application with the words “Quaker Cabins Bookkeeper” so we know you read the complete job description.

## Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



* Uploading and managing products

* Creating, drafting and improving product listings

* Checking product titles, images, descriptions and variants

* Monitoring product pricing and margins

* Updating pricing when necessary

* Performing product and listing quality checks

* Checking whether products match supplier information

* Communicating with our backend and supplier teams

* Following up on product and operational issues

* Maintaining finance and operational spreadsheets

* Keeping an overview across multiple stores

* Identifying problems and proactively solving them

* Making sure daily store operations are completed correctly

* Potentially assisting with product research in the future

You should:



* Have previous experience managing Google Shopping / Google dropshipping stores

* Understand the front-end operations of an e-commerce store

* Be comfortable managing large numbers of products

* Have strong attention to detail

* Be organized and able to work across multiple stores

The starting workload is approximately:



2–5 hours per day

* Salary increases

title: TikTok Shop Video Editor
description:
I’m looking for a creative and reliable TikTok Shop short-form video editor to work with me on an ongoing basis.



I am an active TikTok Shop LIVE seller and am looking to increase the amount of shoppable video content I post. I will provide raw product footage, product information/listings, and direction when needed. Your job will be to turn that footage into engaging, polished TikTok Shop videos.



This is a very part-time position to start, approximately 5–10 short-form videos per week. The workload may vary from week to week, and there is potential for the position to grow over time.



What I need:



Edit approximately 5–10 TikTok Shop videos per week

Most videos will be approximately 15–60 seconds

Create a strong hook within the first 1–3 seconds

Add engaging on-screen text and captions

Add appropriate music, sound effects, transitions and cuts

Highlight product benefits and selling points

Add a clear call-to-action when appropriate

Turn raw footage into a finished video without needing step-by-step instructions for every edit

Upload completed videos to our shared Google Drive



Ideal candidate:



Experience editing TikTok, Reels or other short-form content

CapCut experience preferred

TikTok Shop/e-commerce experience is a big plus

Understands hooks, retention and fast-paced short-form content

Creative and able to suggest improvements

Good written English

Reliable communication and turnaround times

Interested in a long-term working relationship



Pay:

This position can be hourly or per completed video depending on experience and your preferred arrangement. Please include your expected hourly rate and/or rate per completed short-form video when applying.



To apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself

Your editing experience

2–3 examples of short-form videos you personally edited

Any TikTok Shop or e-commerce editing experience

The editing software you use

Your typical turnaround time

Your hourly rate and/or per-video rate



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a small test edit using raw footage I provide before I choose an editor.



I am looking for someone dependable that I can build a long-term working relationship with as my TikTok Shop business grows.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive Staff Accountant to join our fast-growing finance team. This role plays a key part in the day to-day management of Accounts Payable (AP), Vendor Management, General Ledger (GL) coding, Accounts Receivable (AR), and Franchise/Tenant billing and collections, while also assisting in treasury operations, including intercompany transfers and settlement activities.



This position requires strong ownership, accuracy, urgency, and a continuous improvement mindset. The ideal candidate has a passion for numbers, thrives in a fast paced environment, and is naturally curious with a knack for problem-solving and streamlining operations.



Key Responsibilities:



Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

- Process vendor invoices, ensure accurate GL coding, and manage timely payments via Ramp.

- Maintain and update vendor records; onboard new vendors and validate documentation.

- Perform regular reconciliations and ensure compliance with internal controls.

Accounts Receivable & Billing

- Prepare and issue billings to franchisees and tenants; monitor and -manage collections.

- Work closely with operations to reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies promptly.

- Provide regular updates and AR aging analysis to management.

Treasury & Intercompany

- Assist with daily cash management and positioning; support payment

processing and approvals.

- Monitor and manage intercompany activity, settlements, and bank transfers.

- Support treasury reporting, banking relationships, and reconciliation of balances across entities.

Reporting & General Ledger

- Perform accurate and timely GL coding and journal entries related to

transactional accounting.

- Assist in the preparation of month-end and year-end financial reports.

- Track and analyze spend trends and report exceptions or variances from budget/forecast.

Continuous Improvement & Support

- Identify and implement opportunities for process optimization and automation.

- Serve as a go-to resource for systems such as Microsoft Dynamics GP

Collaborate cross-functionally with finance, operations, and external partners.

Qualifications & Requirements:



CPA/CMA License required.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

3-5 years of hands-on accounting experience in a transactional or general accounting role.

Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics GP highly preferred.

Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, modeling); experience with financial systems and dashboards a plus.

Demonstrated attention to detail, speed, and accuracy in a high-volume environment.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to ask why and dig deeper.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Proven ability to manage multiple priorities with urgency and efficiency.

Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive and solutions-oriented approach.

Comfortable working in both collaborative and independent settings.

title: Urgent Hiring: Senior Integrations & Platform Engineer
description:
Important Notice to Applicants:



Please note that we are only contacting and communicating with candidates through OnlineJobsPH. Any applications or direct contact made outside of these channels, including
s, social media messages, direct messages to our CEO, or messages sent to our general company
, will not be considered and will be automatically declined.



About the Company:



We are a private U.S.-based company operating across multiple departments that support legal, staffing, and client-service operations. Our teams collaborate in dynamic, fast-paced environments focused on innovation, integrity, and client success.



In this role, you’ll work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams, making a real impact in operational, legal, and client-focused projects—all from the comfort of your home. Details about our company structure and associated teams will be introduced during the interview process.



About the Role:



We are building an AI-enabled intake and conversion platform for law firms. Our human and AI agents engage prospective clients, complete intake workflows, and help firms convert qualified prospects into signed clients. 



That only works if information moves reliably between our platform, our clients' systems, and the partners that supply leads. You will design and build that integration platform — production APIs, event-driven services, and CRM connectors — leading technical discovery yourself and turning recurring requirements into reusable capabilities rather than one-off scripts. 



What You Will Build:



Client APIs and Event Delivery 



Build secure, documented APIs and a reliable webhook platform that deliver intake, lead, and conversion outcomes to client systems. 



Own delivery mechanics and API standards: subscriptions, authentication, webhook signing, retries, idempotency, replay, versioning, and the documentation and testing tools customers need to self-serve. 



Inbound Lead and Partner Integrations



Build services that securely accept leads and potential cases from external vendors on behalf of hundreds of law-firm clients, built on a canonical intake model and an adapter framework that normalizes new partners without duplicating core logic. 



Handle validation, deduplication, attribution, consent and source tracking, and tenant routing, and build monitoring and reconciliation tools that make missing or misrouted leads visible and recoverable. 



CRM Connectors and Custom Client Work



Turn recurring client requirements into reusable, configurable connectors — installable packages, managed integrations, and embedded workflows — with secure OAuth or API-key onboarding. 



Design configurable field mapping, routing rules, and synchronization behavior so a new firm can be connected without an engineer, and own connector deployment, versioning, and support. 



Lead technical discovery with law firms, CRM administrators, and vendors; deliver custom integrations as paid engagements when a connector is not appropriate; and fold reusable components back into the platform. 



Platform, Reliability, and Security:



Design multi-tenant, event-driven services with strong isolation of customer data and credentials, and own them from design through deployment, monitoring, and i
 response. 



Design for third-party rate limits, outages, schema changes, and duplicate events, backed by structured observability, automated contract and integration testing, and replay tools. 



Protect sensitive lead, caller, and case data through least-privilege access, secure secret storage, credential rotation, tenant-aware authorization, and configurable retention. 





Required Experience:



Typically 5 or more years of software engineering experience, including ownership of backend, platform, or integration systems. 



Hands-on experience designing and operating customer-facing APIs, webhooks, or integration platforms in production. 



Strong proficiency in a modern backend language (TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, Go, or C#) plus strong SQL and relational data modeling. 



Deep understanding of event-driven systems, distributed-system failure modes, and API authentication patterns including OAuth 2.0, API keys, JWTs, and signed requests. 



Experience designing reliable integration behavior — retries, idempotency, rate limiting, replay, reconciliation, and schema evolution — backed by automated contract and integration testing. 



Experience with multi-tenant SaaS and operating services in AWS, Azure, or GCP using containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. 



Experience working directly with customers and partners on discovery and launch, translating messy business processes into maintainable software, and a self-directed approach to ambiguous problems. 



Preferred Experience:



Integrations with CRM, case-management, or lead-management platforms such as Salesforce, Litify, HubSpot, Filevine, Clio, or Lawmatics. 



Salesforce work involving Apex, REST APIs, Platform Events, Flow, or managed packages, or publishing installable apps, marketplace connectors, or SDKs. 



Legal technology, law-firm operations, legal intake, or professional-services delivery, including billable client engagements. 



SFTP, batch imports, change-data capture, or streaming platforms, and familiarity with MCP or secure data interfaces for AI agents. 



Depth in one or two platforms, plus the ability to learn unfamiliar APIs and data models quickly, matters more than familiarity with all of them. 



What Success Looks Like:



Clients and partners exchange standardized outcomes and leads through reliable, documented interfaces instead of manual work. 



Integration failures are visible, diagnosable, and recoverable. 



New vendors and CRM systems are added through reusable adapters and configuration, so onboarding each new client, CRM, or lead source takes less time.



How to Apply



Please send your application ONLY to 



Make sure your subject line begins with:



“Sr. Integrations and Platform Engineer – [Your Name]”



This helps us correctly identify your application and confirms that you’ve read the full job description carefully.

This is a hands-on operations role for someone who has already worked with inventory records, order fulfilment, stock reconciliations, and ideally Amazon Seller Central/FBA. You will work closely with our Inventory Manager and third-party logistics partners to make sure stock records are reliable, Amazon shipments are handled correctly, and discrepancies are caught before they affect customers or sales.

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
# YouTube Video Editor — B-Roll, Graphics & Visual Storytelling



**Real Estate & Sacramento Lifestyle | Part-Time | Long-Term**



Hi! I'm a real estate professional building a YouTube channel focused on Sacramento-area neighborhoods, lifestyle, relocation, and real estate.



I'm looking for a talented **YouTube video editor who is especially strong at visual storytelling, B-roll, graphics, maps, photos and viewer retention.**



## IMPORTANT: My Footage Will Already Be Pre-Edited



I will provide you with a **pre-edited video each week**.



I will already have:



* Selected the speaking footage I want to use

* Removed mistakes and unwanted sections

* Removed unnecessary pauses

* Established the speaking cadence and pacing

* Put the content in the order I want it presented



**You will NOT be responsible for editing down hours of raw talking-head footage or deciding what parts of my presentation to keep.**



Your job begins with my pre-edited speaking video.



Your primary responsibility is to take that video and make it **visually interesting, polished and engaging to watch.**



## What You'll Be Editing



I plan to publish approximately **one long-form YouTube video per week**.



Topics will include:



* Sacramento-area neighborhoods and communities

* Living in Sacramento

* Relocating to the Sacramento area

* Neighborhood and community comparisons

* Real estate education

* Local lifestyle

* Community tours and information

* Talking-head educational videos



My videos are designed to help prospective home buyers learn about the Sacramento area and ultimately generate real estate leads.



## Your Primary Job: Visual Storytelling



I don't want someone who simply adds random stock footage every 30 seconds.



I want an editor who listens carefully to what I'm saying and asks:



**"What could the viewer SEE right now that would make this more interesting, easier to understand, or more compelling?"**



Depending on the content, that could include:



* Relevant B-roll

* Maps and location graphics

* Neighborhood and community imagery

* Photos

* Charts and graphs

* On-screen statistics or key facts

* Text callouts

* Animated titles

* Property or lifestyle imagery

* Screen captures

* Visual comparisons

* Zooms or other subtle movement

* Pattern interrupts

* Music and sound design when appropriate

* Other visual elements that support the story and improve viewer retention



The visuals should **support what I'm saying**, not distract from it.



I want the finished videos to feel professional and engaging without feeling overly flashy, gimmicky or over-edited.



## What I Need From You



You should be able to:



* Understand spoken English extremely well

* Understand the meaning and context of what I'm saying

* Identify opportunities for visual storytelling

* Find appropriate B-roll, photos and other visual assets

* Create attractive maps, graphics, charts and visual comparisons

* Add tasteful on-screen text and callouts

* Understand YouTube viewer retention and visual pacing

* Add appropriate pattern interrupts without overdoing them

* Clean and balance audio if needed

* Perform basic color correction if needed

* Add appropriate music and sound design

* Create clean transitions

* Maintain a consistent visual style from video to video

* Follow instructions and established brand guidelines

* Accept feedback and make revisions

* Meet agreed-upon weekly deadlines



Experience editing **real estate, relocation, lifestyle, travel, educational or location-based YouTube content** is a major plus.



## What I DON'T Need



This is NOT a general Virtual Assistant position.



You will not be responsible for:



* Managing my CRM

* Managing leads

* Managing my

* Managing my calendar

* Business administration

* Editing hours of raw talking-head footage



You also will not initially need access to my YouTube account, client databases or other business systems.



I will provide the pre-edited video.



**Your job is to make it visually excellent.**



## What I'm Looking For



I care a lot about:



* Excellent visual storytelling

* Strong English comprehension

* Good creative judgment

* Reliability

* Attention to detail

* Good communication

* Understanding YouTube retention

* Ability to research and select relevant visuals

* Ability to follow an established style

* Meeting deadlines

* Being comfortable asking questions when something is unclear



I'm looking for someone I can work with **long-term** and who can learn the look and feel of my channel over time.



## Schedule & Compensation



This is a part-time position for approximately **one long-form YouTube video per week**.



Because the speaking footage will already be edited, I'm open to either an hourly or **per-video rate**.



If hourly, my anticipated starting range is approximately **$7–$9 USD/hour depending on experience, skill and efficiency.**



After we've worked together on several videos and understand the typical workload, I'm open to establishing a consistent per-video rate.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please do NOT send me a giant portfolio.



Instead, send me:



**1. Your 3 best LONG-FORM YouTube videos that YOU personally edited.**



I'm especially interested in examples that demonstrate:



* B-roll

* Visual storytelling

* Maps

* Graphics

* Photos

* Charts or data visualization

* On-screen text

* Pattern interrupts

* Strong visual pacing



Talking-head, educational, lifestyle, travel or real-estate examples are especially helpful.



**2. Tell me exactly what you personally did on those three videos.**



**3. What editing software do you use?**



**4. What tools do you use to create maps, graphics, animations or other visual elements?**



**5. Where do you typically source B-roll, photos, music and other assets, and how do you make sure those assets can legally be used in a client's YouTube videos?**



**6. If I provide a pre-edited 15–20 minute talking-head video with the speaking cuts and pacing already completed, approximately how many hours would you expect to spend adding the visual storytelling and finishing the video?**



**7. What is your desired hourly rate or per-video rate?**



**8. Tell me about your experience editing videos for English-speaking creators.**



**9. Please send me a 60–90 second video introducing yourself in English.**



It does NOT need to be professionally edited. I simply want to meet you and hear how you communicate.



Finally, begin your application with the words:



**SACRAMENTO EDITOR**



Applications that don't include those words will not be considered.



## Paid Editing Test



I will select a small number of finalists and give each person the **same short piece of my pre-edited footage**.



This will be a **paid test**.



Your assignment will be to add the B-roll, graphics, maps, photos, text, music, sound design and other visual elements you believe will make that section engaging and easy to understand.



I'll provide some examples of the editing style I like, but I also want to see your creative judgment.



I'm looking for the editor who can take what I'm saying and **visually tell the story with me** — not simply add effects for the sake of adding effects.



If we're a great fit, I'd love for this to become a long-term working relationship.

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media VA for Two Established ASMR Channels
description:
hort-Form Video Editor & Social Media VA for Two Established ASMR Channels



Part-time | Remote | Long-term freelance role



Starting rate: $7 USD/hour



Approx. 10–15 hours per week initially



About the Role



Hi! I'm an established ASMR content creator looking for a reliable, creative and organised Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media VA to take ownership of the short-form content pipeline across two ASMR channels.



I already work with an editor for my long-form YouTube content, so you will not be responsible for editing my main long-form videos.



Instead, you'll receive completed long-form videos and turn them into engaging short-form content for platforms including YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok.



This role goes beyond simply being given timestamps and cutting clips.



I'm looking for someone who can develop a strong understanding of my content and audiences and eventually independently recognise:



"That's a great Short."



You'll help identify the best moments, edit them, organise the finished files, schedule content, monitor performance, keep an eye on trends and suggest ways we can improve the short-form strategy.



The two channels have different styles and audiences, so part of the role will also involve learning what works for each channel individually.



I'm looking for someone interested in developing a long-term freelance working relationship rather than completing occasional one-off edits.



What You'll Be Doing



For each new completed long-form video, the benchmark will normally be to create at least 7 pieces of short-form content, including:



1 trailer-style Short showcasing several appealing moments from the full video, plus 6+ standalone Shorts built around particularly strong ASMR moments.



Some videos will naturally contain more than seven great clips. If you spot them, I want you to use your judgement rather than stopping because you've reached a quota.



Quality is more important than hitting an arbitrary number.



Your regular responsibilities will include:



Reviewing completed long-form ASMR videos and identifying the strongest short-form moments.

Editing engaging 9:16 vertical videos, generally around 60–90 seconds where appropriate.

Creating trailer-style edits promoting new long-form videos.

Carefully reframing/cropping horizontal footage for vertical viewing.

Maintaining the relaxing atmosphere and original ASMR audio.

Keeping editing clean, intentional and appropriate to ASMR rather than using unnecessary fast cuts or heavy effects.

Preparing appropriate titles, captions and descriptions using existing guidelines.

Organising completed edits within Google Drive.

Scheduling approved content through Buffer across the relevant social platforms.

Maintaining the short-form content pipeline within Notion.

Keeping track of what has been edited, approved, scheduled and published.

Monitoring performance and using those results to improve future clip selection.



Our Workflow



We use three main tools to keep the workflow organised:



Google Drive — video files



Notion — content planning and workflow



Buffer — social media scheduling



The monthly content overview will be available within Notion, so you'll be able to see what content is currently planned, being produced, ready for short-form editing and scheduled.



Once a long-form video has been fully edited, I will upload the completed video to Google Drive.



You'll download/work from that completed version and identify the strongest potential Shorts.



Once you've completed the short-form edits, you'll upload the finished files back into the appropriate Google Drive folder, following an agreed file naming and folder structure.



The general workflow will therefore be:



Long-form video completed

→ Uploaded to Google Drive

→ Identify potential Shorts

→ Edit Shorts + trailer

→ Upload completed edits to Google Drive

→ Review/approval

→ Schedule approved content through Buffer

→ Update status in Notion

→ Monitor published content and performance



Initially, I'll review the content before it is scheduled.



As we work together and you develop a strong understanding of my editing preferences, channels and audiences, I'd like you to become increasingly independent and eventually take greater ownership of this process.



New Content & Back Catalogue



The workload will naturally vary from week to week because I won't necessarily publish new long-form videos on both channels every week.



Newly completed long-form content will always take priority.



However, both channels also have extensive back catalogues containing years of content.



During quieter production weeks, rather than simply waiting for a new video, you'll use some of your available time to explore the back catalogue and identify opportunities for new short-form content.



This might include:



Finding strong moments that have never previously been turned into Shorts.

Creating new Shorts from older long-form videos.

Re-editing older short-form content with a stronger opening or structure.

Reframing or shortening previously used clips.

Identifying older videos that have suddenly become relevant again.

Repurposing successful themes, triggers or concepts.

Building a bank of evergreen Shorts that can be scheduled in advance.



The goal is to create a consistent short-form content pipeline even during weeks when there isn't a new long-form upload.



Trends, Testing & Experimentation



Part of this role involves keeping an eye on what is currently happening across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.



I'm particularly interested in trends within ASMR, relaxation, personal attention, beauty, wellness and other relevant neighbouring niches.



I don't want to chase every viral trend or force my content into formats that don't suit it.



However, if you notice a trend, hook, format, editing technique or type of ASMR content that you believe could naturally work for either channel, I want you to feel comfortable suggesting it.



You may also notice that an existing Short contains a great underlying moment but didn't perform particularly well.



In those situations, I want you to think creatively about whether it could be reworked and tested again — perhaps with:



A different opening moment.

A tighter edit.

Different framing.

A different duration.

A different sequence.

A different caption or presentation.

A format inspired by a current trend.



Part of the job is therefore testing and learning, rather than assuming every published Short gets one chance and is then forgotten.



Monthly Performance Report



At the end of each month, you'll prepare a short performance report covering both channels.



This does not need to be a complicated presentation. A clear, useful report within Google Drive is perfect.



I'd like the report to look at things such as which Shorts performed particularly well or poorly, differences between the two channels, which ASMR triggers/themes appear strongest, whether particular openings or video lengths are performing better, differences between platforms, results from re-edits or experiments, and any relevant trends you've noticed.



Most importantly, I'd like you to finish with 3–5 practical recommendations for the following month.



I'm interested not only in:



"Here's what happened."



but also:



"Here's what I think we should try next."



What Makes a Good Short for Me?



ASMR is different from conventional short-form content.



I don't want constant jump cuts, huge animated captions, loud sound effects or frantic editing designed to fight for attention.



The content should remain calming and satisfying while still giving someone a reason to stop scrolling and continue watching.



Strong moments might include:



Close-up personal attention.

Visually satisfying repetitive movements.

Particularly good ASMR sounds.

Face touching / soft-touch sequences.

Examinations and treatments.

Massage or spa-style moments.

Unusual objects or techniques.

Interesting roleplay interactions.

Moments that immediately make someone curious about what's happening.

Particularly relaxing or hypnotic sequences.



A good candidate will gradually develop an instinct for which moments are worth extracting without needing me to provide timestamps.



Who I'm Looking For



You'll probably be a great fit if you have experience editing vertical short-form content and have a strong sense of pacing, aesthetics and viewer attention.



You should be organised, reliable and comfortable managing your own workload.



A genuine understanding of ASMR would be a significant advantage. Previous professional ASMR editing experience isn't essential, but you should understand that the pacing and editing philosophy can be very different from conventional TikTok/Reels content.



You should also:



Have good written and spoken English.

Have a strong eye for vertical framing and cropping.

Be comfortable working independently.

Be willing to learn the personalities and audiences of two different channels.

Be comfortable receiving feedback.

Be proactive about suggesting improvements.

Be able to use or quickly learn Google Drive, Notion and Buffer.

Have an interest in social-media performance and trends.



You may use Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut or another professional editing workflow. I'm much more interested in the quality of your work and your creative judgement than the specific software you use.



Hours & Pay



Starting rate: $7 USD per hour.



I'm expecting approximately 10–15 hours per week initially, although the workload will vary depending on my production schedule.



There are no fixed working hours and you do not need to work UK hours, provided agreed deadlines are met and communication is reliable.



During weeks with multiple new long-form videos, those will take priority.



During quieter weeks, hours can instead be spent working through the back catalogue, building content ahead, re-editing existing material, researching relevant trends, scheduling content and analysing performance.



Payment will be made via PayPal.



This is a freelance position rather than employment. Before beginning regular work, we'll both agree to a simple written freelance working agreement covering the scope of the role, hourly rate, payments, confidentiality, account access, ownership of completed work and how either of us can end the working arrangement.



Bonuses & Progression



I want excellent work and initiative to be recognised.



Performance and discretionary bonuses may be available in addition to the normal hourly rate.



These might be awarded for exceptional-performing content, consistently excellent work, significant audience growth, particularly successful ideas or experiments, taking greater ownership of the workflow, or going above and beyond during busy periods.



If the collaboration works particularly well, there is also scope for increased hours, greater responsibility and an increased hourly rate over time.



How to Apply



Please send a short application answering the following:



Tell me briefly about your video editing experience.

Do you personally watch ASMR? If so, which creators or styles do you enjoy?

Please send 2–3 examples of short-form videos you've personally edited.

If you were given a 30-minute ASMR video, how would you d
 which moments should become Shorts?

What do you think makes someone stop scrolling and continue watching a relaxing/ASMR Short?

How would you approach creating multiple Shorts from one long-form video without them feeling repetitive?

Which editing software do you normally use?

Have you previously used Google Drive, Notion and/or Buffer?

Are you comfortable monitoring short-form trends and suggesting ideas rather than simply completing assigned edits?

How many hours per week are you currently available?

Are you comfortable working independently once you've learned my preferred style?



Finally, please begin your application with the word ***TINGLES*** so I know you've read the entire job description.



Short answers are absolutely fine. I'm much more interested in your creative judgement, editing examples and understanding of short-form content than receiving a perfectly written application.



Shortlisted Applicants



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a small paid editing test using one of my long-form videos.



The test will be paid at $20 USD.



This will allow me to see how you personally identify strong ASMR moments, approach vertical editing and understand the style of the channels before either of us commits to an ongoing working relationship.

title: HIRING DIRECT: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator & Team Administrative Assistant. STABLE JOB with an experienced team!
description:
Homeology Real Estate is hiring an experienced Transaction Coordinator & Team Administrative Assistant based in the Philippines.



We are a real estate team serving the Greater Sacramento area in California. We are looking for someone organized, proactive, and dependable who can help coordinate our transactions and keep our daily team operations running smoothly.



This is a full time remote opportunity for someone interested in becoming a valued, long term member of our team.



POSITION DETAILS



• Full time: 40 hours per week.

• Schedule: Monday through Friday. Hours of the day can be discussed. 

• This may requires overnight availability in the Philippines and follows California daylight saving time changes.

• Compensation: $8–$10 USD per hour, depending on relevant experience and qualifications.

• Work directly with our team leader, agents, and support staff.



TRANSACTION COORDINATION



You will coordinate the administrative side of buyer and seller transactions under the direction of our agents and brokerage.



Responsibilities include:



• Open transaction files, maintain checklists, and track important dates from accepted contract through closing.

• Monitor inspection, appraisal, financing, contingency, and closing deadlines. Send reminders and promptly flag approaching deadlines or delays.

• Coordinate inspection scheduling and follow up on reports and outstanding items.

• Communicate professionally with agents, clients, escrow, title, lenders, inspectors, and other transaction participants.

• Organize documents, check for missing signatures or information, and follow up on outstanding paperwork.

• Enter and maintain transaction files in SkySlope and keep SISU records and transaction updates current.

• Prepare and route agent-approved paperwork through our team DocuSign account.

• Assist with listing paperwork, disclosures, and agent-directed modifications such as price reductions. MLS entry is outside this role.

• Follow brokerage submission procedures and resolve administrative file deficiencies.

• Use a dedicated team
 account, team signature, and Slack for consistent communication.



Agents and the team leader handle negotiations, contract interpretation, client advice, and transaction decisions.



TEAM ADMINISTRATION



You will also help manage recurring administrative tasks, including:



• Maintain accurate records in Follow Up Boss and SISU, including keeping our client records up to date as transactions close. 

• Prepare recurring activity reports, lead audits, and accountability updates.

• Coordinate agent onboarding and offboarding checklists, paperwork, and administrative follow-up.

• Prepare team announcements, meeting reminders, calendar updates, and event communications.

• Create and update Canva materials, open house flyers, social media content, and
 newsletters using team templates and approval procedures.

• Organize client appreciation campaigns, gift lists, birthdays, home anniversaries, and mailing information.

• Coordinate materials and instructions with local team members who handle physical preparation and delivery.

• Maintain recruiting lists, shared files, task checklists, and written procedures.

• Follow through on recurring assignments and suggest practical improvements to our processes.



Transaction deadlines and urgent client needs take priority. We will establish a clear schedule for recurring administrative responsibilities.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Previous hands on experience coordinating California residential real estate transactions (MINIMUM 2 YEARS)

• Familiarity with California real estate forms, disclosures, transaction timelines, and brokerage file requirements.

• Experience supporting multiple agents and managing several active files.

• Good written and spoken English, including confidence communicating by phone,
, and Zoom.

• Strong attention to detail and consistent follow through.

• Ability to prioritize assignments, identify missing information, and raise questions before an issue becomes urgent.

• Comfort learning new technology and following established systems.

• Professional handling of confidential client and business information.

• Reliable computer, dependable internet, a quiet workspace, and a practical backup plan for connectivity or power interruptions.



Experience with SkySlope and DocuSign is especially valuable. Familiarity with Follow Up Boss, SISU, Slack, Canva, and Mailchimp is a plus.



This role is NOT for someone just getting into it. This is for someone who has worked as a transaction coordinator here in California previously. We will provide training on Homeology’s systems and procedures for the ADMIN side of things. 



HOW TO APPLY



Please use “Homeology TC & Admin” as your application subject and include:



1. Your résumé and a brief introduction explaining why this position interests you.

2. Your California transaction coordination experience, including buyer and seller files and your typical number of active transactions.

3. The responsibilities you personally handled in your previous TC and administrative roles.

4. The software platforms you have used.

5. Your requested hourly rate, earliest available start date, and confirmation that you can work 40 hours per week during California business hours.

6. A brief answer to this question: An inspection deadline is tomorrow, the report has not arrived, and the agent is reaching out to you. What would you do?



Please have professional references available for the interview stage.

title: Caregiver Scheduler & Care Team Support
description:
Caregiver Scheduler & Care Team Support - Job Description



Our purpose is Making Lives Better through Happier Aging. We help seniors stay in their homes for as long as they choose, and our real talent is caring and connecting to seniors’ hearts. We have a mission to help seniors continue doing what they love most. We are not just another homecare company fulfilling daily tasks, we are a company that admires people and seeks to make a difference in everything we do. By working at Nurse Next Door you will be part of a growing company that is helping seniors do what they love again.



As a member of the Nurse Next Door team, you understand how to hustle with heart - this is essential! You enjoy working collaboratively but with a high degree of autonomy and thrive by seeing results. You are a self-led leader who takes responsibility for your own actions. You show care by engaging in intentional, compassionate conversations to help others achieve their fullest potential. You are inspired by the idea of being involved with an organization that is changing the way we deliver home care through our Happier Aging philosophy.



As a Caregiver Scheduler & Care Team Support, you are responsible for the effective operation of several administrative processes, namely the caregiver scheduling function, in the Nurse Next Door office and for providing back-up support for the Pinellas based Care Team.



You impact growth through the following duties and responsibilities:



Client Care Delivery:

? Coordinates with Care Designer and Care Services Center to become aware of all open and vacant shifts.

? Work to cover all caregiver call-off visits, ensuring that the client’s services are provided without interruption.

? Build, update and manage Caregiver schedules.

? With the guidance of the Care Designer, match Caregivers and clients based on fit, availability, location and consistency.

? Quick and thoughtful response to callouts and schedule changes to ensure that the client does not have any service interruptions.

? Maintain updated documentation in the AlayaCare EMR and scheduling tool.

? Prompt and clear communication status of schedule to caregivers, clients and Nurse Next Door leadership team members.



Scheduling Collaboration:

? Delivers exceptional Client service by achieving scheduling goals and responding to urgent inquiries, as directed by the Care Designer.

? Liaises with the Care Services Center team to communicate changes in Client requirements and caregiver assignments, as directed by the Care Designer.

? Assist with ensuring that client coverage is secured, particularly due to urgent care, Caregiver cancellations and limited availability.

? Work with Recrutier to ensure new-hires are contacted by phone to introduce them to the organization and begin scheduling new clients and care.

? Contacting caregivers to follow up on the assigned shifts to ensure they are in attendance.



Care Team Support:

? Promptly notify the Care Team of changes in the caregiving schedule.

? Contact clients to update them on changes in care and schedule, as required and assigned by the Care Desinger.

? Keep track of all newly-hired employees and their first shifts to ensure that they are paid for training.

? Become familiar with the Alayacare application and it's uses to assist caregivers with troubleshooting support.

? Serve as a resource for Caregvier issues, open Helpdesk tickets for caregiver to resolve technical issues when needed.

? Serve as secondary Recruiter to assist with hiring when needed. 

? Follows up with needed updates.

? Attend and participate in weekly team meetings.



Availability:

? Flexibility is required

? Full time (40 + hrs. per wk.)



Business Relationships:

? Reports to the Care Designer with a dotted line to the CES.

? Partner with Care Designer, Community Engagement Specialist to anticipate client staffing needs, based on new clients and anticipated callouts/absences.

? Works very closely with the People Experience Coordinator (Recruiter) to ensure that all newly hired employees are available to take cases upon completion of Discovery Day.

? Works closely in partnership with Care Services Center to ensure that emergency care and callouts are staffed quickly and efficiently, with little to no interruption in the service provided to the client.

? Work with Care Team as Recruiting function in order to ensure hiring needs are met, when necessary. 



Key Metrics:

? NPS; Client and Employee Score of 10



Qualifications:

? Education Requirements:

? Prefer someone with a college background.

? Prior Home Care schedulilng experience is required.

? Prior experience building relationships with caregivers and clients.

?Excellent customer service skills are required.



Experience Requirements:

? Must have working computer to schedule and phone to use Ring Central.

? Prior scheduling and customer services experience is required.

? Some prior recruiting experience. 

? Homecare background is a plus.

? Strong computer skills, proficient in G-Suite: Gmail, drive, docs, calendar/ MS office.

? Must have a reliable computer and telephone to manage the schedule and to make calls to Caregivers to ensure shift coverage. (RingCentral - VoIP app.)

? Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.

? Intentional organization, planning, time management and multitasking skills.

? Customer service and leadership background considered an asset.



How to Apply:

? Submit a resume with a cover letter telling us about you. (Why does our mission appeal to you)?

? Your requested pay rate per/hr. (max $2,000 monthly).

? Your typical weekly availability. (We operate in Eastern Time as a US based company - 12 hr shifts).

title: eCommerce Marketing Assistant (Amazon, Walmart REQUIRED)
description:
Important Requirement

To be considered for this position, you MUST have at least 1 year of hands-on experience managing both Amazon and Walmart marketplaces.



Applications without direct experience on both Amazon and Walmart will not be considered.



Please clearly describe your Amazon and Walmart experience in your cover letter, including the type of work you performed on each platform.



Experience with Best Buy Marketplace and/or Mirakl-powered marketplaces is a strong plus.



About the Role



We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven E-Commerce Specialist to join our growing team.



You will be responsible for day-to-day marketplace operations and helping drive sales performance across multiple E-Commerce channels, including Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, and Best Buy.



The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly inside marketplace seller portals, managing listings and inventory, monitoring advertising and sales performance, troubleshooting marketplace issues, and identifying opportunities for growth.



Required Experience



* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience with both Amazon and Walmart marketplaces

* 1–2+ years of experience in E-Commerce, online marketplace management, marketing, or sales

* Experience managing product listings, inventory, pricing, promotions, or marketplace operations

* Strong understanding of E-Commerce fundamentals and marketplace best practices

* Comfortable working with sales data, spreadsheets, and performance reports



Key Responsibilities



* Manage daily operations across Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, and Best Buy

* Create, update, optimize, and maintain product listings to improve visibility and conversion

* Monitor marketplace account health and resolve listing, inventory, pricing, and operational issues

* Track inventory levels across marketplaces and coordinate replenishment to minimize stockouts

* Manage and optimize PPC advertising campaigns with a focus on sales growth and ROI

* Monitor pricing, promotions, competitors, and marketplace performance

* Analyze sales, advertising, and operational data and provide actionable recommendations

* Stay current on marketplace policies, tools, trends, and platform updates

* Identify new products, channels, promotions, and other opportunities to increase revenue

* Coordinate with supervisors on marketing campaigns, promotions, and sales strategies

* Communicate with clients, suppliers, marketplace support teams, and internal team members as needed

* Assist with onboarding and managing new E-Commerce marketplaces and sales channels

* Support the broader team in achieving sales and operational goals



Preferred Qualifications



* Experience with Best Buy Marketplace

* Experience working with Mirakl or other Mirakl-powered marketplaces

* Experience managing Amazon and/or Walmart PPC advertising

* Familiarity with Shopify and eBay

* Basic graphic design skills using tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and manage multiple priorities

* Willingness to learn new platforms and adapt as the business grows



Why Join Us?



This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys E-Commerce, takes initiative, and wants hands-on experience managing multiple major online marketplaces.



You will have the opportunity to work across established channels such as Amazon and Walmart while also gaining exposure to additional marketplaces, including Best Buy and Mirakl-powered platforms.



If you are detail-oriented, motivated by results, and excited to grow alongside an expanding E-Commerce business, we’d love to hear from you.



To be considered, please include a brief description of your hands-on Amazon and Walmart experience in your cover letter.
