title: RECRUITER - TALENT & TEAM
description:
This job is very straightforward. We’re a growing video-ads agency, and we need one person whose ENTIRE

job is finding and winning great people — actors for our shoots, video editors, QA specialists, copywriters,

and every other role as we grow. You find them, message them, SELL them on working with us, screen

them, run their trial tasks, and hand the best ones over ready to grade. You don’t make the final hiring calls

— our team grades every trial and audition — but everything up to that door is yours.



We make video ads — real conversations that sell. Every ad

needs actors, an editor, a QA specialist, and a copywriter — and as we add clients, we constantly need more

of all of them. Right now our managers spend hours a day searching and messaging people. Your job is to take

ALL of that off their plates and do it better, every single day.



WHAT THE JOB ACTUALLY IS

● Find ACTORS for our video shoots. Search Backstage and social platforms in the cities we shoot in

(Toronto, New York, London), check profiles fast, send personalized messages, and get interested

actors booked onto audition calls with our Talent Manager. You’ll rotate accounts, follow our proven

message templates, and keep the pipeline full for every shoot.



● Find VIDEO EDITORS, QA SPECIALISTS, COPYWRITERS — every team role. Post our job ads on

OnlineJobs.ph, LinkedIn, and
 groups · search jobseeker profiles and DM the good ones (30+

personalized messages a day) · screen replies with our ready-made screening questions · pass the

best candidates to the manager who runs that role’s trial.



● Run the outreach machine. Manage our cold
 campaigns in Instantly (lists get built for you —

you watch replies and respond fast) · keep every job post fresh and running variations · join and post

in new
 groups · always be testing new places to find people.



● SELL the company — you’re our first impression. When someone replies, you make them WANT this:

show them our best work (you’ll have the reference videos ready), explain the role and the recurring

pay clearly, answer their questions from our ready-made FAQ (“is the trial paid?” · “when does it

start?” · “how many videos a month?”), and handle hesitation warmly — the best candidates always

have options, and you’re why they choose us.



● RUN the trial tasks end to end. Each role has a ready-made trial (editors get real raw footage · QA

gets real videos to review). You run the gate first — our screening questions that check they actually

understand our standard — then send the trial package, set the deadline (72 hours), answer their

questions while they work, chase at the deadline, collect the submission, log everything, and pass it

to the manager who grades it. You keep 5+ candidates in trials at all times per open role.



● Keep the trackers perfect. Every person you contact goes in a tracker the same day — name, source,

status, next step. If it’s not logged, it didn’t happen. You’ll send a short weekly report: contacted /

replied / screened / handed over, per role.



● Be FAST. Good editors and actors get taken within days. Every reply gets answered within 24 hours —

usually much faster.



You will never be guessing. Every role has a written playbook — who qualifies, where to search, what to say,

the screening questions, the trial package, the FAQ answers, when to hand over. You follow the playbooks

and make them better with what you learn.



YOU’RE OUR RECRUITER IF...

● You genuinely enjoy outreach — sending 30–50 good messages a day energizes you instead of

draining you

● You can SELL — you know how to make an opportunity sound exciting without overpromising, and

you enjoy winning people over

● You can run a process — send a trial, set a deadline, answer questions mid-task, chase on time,

collect, log, hand over — for several candidates at once without dropping one

● Your written English is excellent — your messages are the first thing every candidate sees of our

company

● You personalize — you’d never send the same copy-paste line to 50 people, because you know it

doesn’t work

● You’re organized to a fault — trackers, follow-ups, statuses, nothing slips

● You’re persistent without being pushy — warm follow-ups, easy outs, no spam energy

● Bonus (not required): experience with OnlineJobs.ph, Backstage, LinkedIn recruiting, Instantly or any

cold-outreach tool.



WHAT WE DON’T WANT

❌  Copy-paste blasters· people who need daily reminders to hit their numbers · slow repliers ·

anyone who finds messaging strangers uncomfortable this job is 80% messaging strangers, kindly and well.



WHY TAKE THIS JOB

Recurring full-time work, not a gig · clear playbooks so you always know what good looks like · your results

are visible weekly (people YOU found will be in our ads and on our team) · you’re measured on output, not

hours-watched · room to grow into leading recruiting as the agency scales.



HOW TO APPLY — ANSWER ALL FIVE

● 1. Your experience with outreach, recruiting, sales, lead generation, or appointment setting — a few

sentences (or “none yet, but...” and make your case).

● 2. THE MINI-TASK (this matters more than your resume): write the exact first message you would

send to a video editor on OnlineJobs.ph whose profile shows great TikTok edits, to get them

interested in an editor role with us. Max 60 words.

● 3. Your expected monthly salary (full-time, remote).

● 4. Your typing speed and daily availability (hours + timezone).

● 5. Which tools you’ve used: OnlineJobs.ph · Backstage · LinkedIn · Instantly · Google Sheets · others.



We reply to every complete application with a real answer to question 2. Applications missing the mini-task

are not reviewed.

title: Community + Operations Assistant
description:
Community + Operations Assistant



Part-Time | Remote | 5–10 Hours/Week

$5–$6 USD/Hour

Independent Contractor



About the Role



The Cain Collective is looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Community + Operations Assistant to support a small number of recurring administrative and community tasks across our business.



This is a part-time, execution-focused role for someone who loves checklists, consistency, organization, and making sure recurring tasks get done without needing to be reminded.



We are not looking for a strategist, high-level client success manager, or technical expert. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of clearly defined recurring responsibilities, follow established processes, communicate when something needs attention, and keep things running smoothly behind the scenes.



The role will begin at approximately 5–10 hours per week, with the potential for additional hours or responsibilities over time.



Primary Responsibilities



VA Leadership Academy Job Board



One of the most important recurring responsibilities in this role will be maintaining our job board for virtual assistants.



Monday through Friday, you will:



Source new virtual assistant job opportunities from established and trusted sources

Review opportunities to ensure they are legitimate, current, remote, and relevant to our community

Check companies and job listings for potential scams or red flags

Add approved opportunities to the VALA Job Board

Check links and job details for accuracy before publishing

Review member-reported listings when needed

Remove or replace expired, broken, or outdated opportunities

Keep the Job Board organized and current



Accuracy matters here. We want our students to feel confident that the opportunities being shared have been thoughtfully reviewed before they are posted.



Mom x VA
 Community



You will help with basic administrative management of our
 community, including:



Reviewing new membership requests

Approving legitimate members who meet the group's requirements

Declining obvious spam, fake, or suspicious accounts

Sending our established welcome message to new members

Helping keep the community organized

Flagging anything unusual or requiring higher-level attention to the appropriate team member



You will not be responsible for coaching members, answering complex questions, creating community strategy, or managing sensitive member situations.



Weekly Operations Cleanup



You will complete a simple recurring operations checklist each week to ensure your areas of responsibility are current and organized.



This may include:



Reviewing the Job Board for expired opportunities

Checking for broken or outdated links

Making sure new
 members have been processed

Completing assigned recurring administrative tasks

Updating internal checklists when tasks are complete

Flagging anything that requires attention from another team member

Additional Administrative Support



From time to time, you may be assigned other simple administrative or recurring operational tasks as the needs of the business evolve.



Any new recurring responsibility will be clearly communicated and added to your scope rather than being assumed as part of the role.



This Role Does NOT Include



This is not a technical implementation role.



You will not be expected to build funnels, create complex automations, troubleshoot software development issues, manage advanced integrations, provide sales support, coach students, develop marketing strategy, or handle complex client experience situations.



Technical projects and higher-level responsibilities are handled separately by other members of our team.



Who We're Looking For



You would be a great fit if you are:



Extremely reliable and consistent

Detail-oriented

Comfortable following SOPs and checklists

Able to work independently without constant reminders

Proactive about communicating when something looks wrong

Comfortable researching information online

Able to identify obvious scams, suspicious websites, and questionable job listings

Organized and able to keep recurring responsibilities on schedule

Comfortable using
, Google Workspace, Slack, and other common online business tools

A strong written communicator in English

Willing to ask questions when you're unsure rather than guessing



Experience supporting an online business, membership community, virtual assistant business, or digital education company is a plus, but not required.



Hours + Compensation



This is an independent contractor position starting at approximately 5–10 hours per week.



Compensation: $5–$6 USD/hour



Hours will be tracked based on time worked. Because several responsibilities occur Monday through Friday, you should have consistent weekday availability to complete assigned recurring tasks.



There is potential for the role and hours to grow as trust is established and additional responsibilities make sense.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role is simple: the recurring responsibilities you own are completed accurately, consistently, and on time.



We should never have to wonder whether the Job Board was updated, whether membership requests were reviewed, or whether your weekly checklist was completed.



You know what you own, you take care of it, and you communicate when something needs our attention.



If you're someone who loves being the reliable person behind the scenes who keeps the little things from becoming big things, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor

title: Senior FFull-Stack Developer / Technical Lead – AI Platform Takeover
description:
We are a UK-based company developing a technology platform combining education, e-commerce, user accounts and an AI-powered assessment service.



The platform has already had development work completed by separate web and AI developers. We are now looking for an experienced senior developer to take technical ownership of the project, audit the existing work, consolidate the development environment and continue the platform through to production.



This is not a new build from scratch. Your first responsibility will be to understand, document and safely take over the existing development.



Current technology includes:



    WordPress



    WooCommerce



    TutorLMS



    Cloudways



    GitHub



    Python



    FastAPI



    REST APIs



    AI/LLM integrations



    databases and third-party services



The AI component has been developed separately as a FastAPI-based service and needs to be reviewed and integrated into the wider platform.

Your first assignment



Your first task will be a technical takeover and audit.



You will be required to review all GitHub repositories provided by the existing developers, independently back up the code, assess what is complete or incomplete, review the current web platform and AI service, identify missing dependencies, understand the current architecture, and confirm what is required to bring the system together.

I Development Responsibility



The platform includes an existing AI-powered skin assessment service that has been developed separately using Python/FastAPI. The successful developer will be expected to audit the current AI codebase, assess its quality and completeness, and determine whether it should be continued, refactored or partially rebuilt.



You may also be responsible for ongoing development of the AI functionality, including the assessment pipeline, API logic, prompts/model integrations, testing, optimisation, deployment and integration with the main platform.



We are therefore particularly interested in developers who are comfortable not only integrating AI services, but also taking technical ownership of an existing AI application and continuing its development where required.



You will also need to:



    review Git history and branches;



    assess the Python/FastAPI AI service;



    review the WordPress platform;



    review databases, APIs and integrations;



    review Cloudways/deployment setup;



    identify missing environment variables or credentials;



    identify security issues and technical debt;



    determine what is required to integrate the AI service with the web platform;



    confirm whether the project can be rebuilt and deployed without relying on the previous developers;



    produce a technical audit report;



    provide a clear roadmap for completion.



Once the takeover is completed, the role may continue into ongoing development.

Ongoing responsibilities



The successful developer may take responsibility for frontend and backend development, Python/FastAPI development, API integrations, AI service integration, WordPress customisation, WooCommerce and TutorLMS integration, database development, user authentication, deployment, testing, bug fixing, GitHub management, staging and production environments, documentation, security and backups.

Essential experience



We are looking for someone with strong experience in Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress, WooCommerce, MySQL/databases, Git/GitHub, cloud/server deployment, API integrations, debugging existing codebases and taking over projects from previous developers.



Experience with AI/LLM integrations, OpenAI or similar APIs, embeddings, vector databases, machine-learning pipelines or AI deployments would be highly desirable.

Important



We need somebody who is comfortable inheriting somebody else’s code.



Please do not apply if your normal approach is to automatically rebuild a project from scratch before properly reviewing the existing system.



Our priority is to preserve the work already completed and determine what can be reused before making any rebuild decisions.

Please answer these questions when applying



    Tell us about a project where you took over an existing codebase from another developer.



    How would you audit a GitHub repository before maintaining it?



    How would you confirm that a transferred repository contains everything needed to run the application?



    What experience do you have with Python and FastAPI?



    Have you connected an AI or LLM backend to a web application?



    What experience do you have with WordPress, WooCommerce or TutorLMS?



    Have you deployed applications to Cloudways, AWS, DigitalOcean or similar platforms?



    If you were given one web application repository and a separate FastAPI AI repository, how would you approach integrating them?



    How would you identify missing API keys, environment variables or external dependencies?



    What would you aim to achieve within your first five working days?



Please begin your application with:



TECHNICAL TAKEOVER



Applications that do not include this will not be reviewed.

title: Marketplace Specialist (Amazon, Faire, Shopify): Part Time, Long Term
description:
SCOOP



Read that word. You will need it. Instructions are at the bottom.



We are a fast-growing US protein ice cream brand. We sell direct to consumers on

Shopify and we are live on Amazon FBA. We are opening two wholesale channels right

now and we need someone who already knows how these platforms work, because we do

not have time to teach the basics.



That last part is the whole job description, honestly. We are not looking for

someone we have to walk through what Faire is or how Amazon Seller Central works.

We are looking for someone who reads "set up our Faire storefront" and already

knows what that means.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



- Manage our Faire wholesale storefront. Review incoming buyer order requests,

  research each buyer, and flag anyone who looks like an Amazon reseller rather

  than a real retail store. This is the single most important task and it starts

  day one.

- Help set up and maintain our RangeMe profile and other wholesale marketplace

  listings.

- Support our Amazon catalog: listing accuracy, content updates, keeping product

  information clean and consistent across channels.

- Keep product data consistent between Shopify, Amazon and our wholesale channels.

- Flag problems before we find them. If a listing is wrong, an order looks

  suspicious, or something is out of stock somewhere it should not be, we want to

  hear it from you first.



WHAT WE NEED YOU TO ALREADY KNOW



You should have hands on experience with at least three of these:

- Faire

- Amazon Seller Central

- Shopify

- Walmart Marketplace

- eBay

- TikTok Shop

- RangeMe



Tell us specifically which ones, and what you actually did on each. "Familiar with

Amazon" tells us nothing. "I managed 40 SKUs on Amazon Seller Central for a

supplement brand, handled listing creation and flat file uploads" tells us

everything.



WHAT WE ARE LIKE TO WORK FOR



- Long term. We are not looking for a one off project. Our current team members

  have been with us a long time and we treat them like real employees.

- We pay every week, on time, through Wise.

- We are small. You will talk directly to the founder and to me. There is no

  layer of managers between you and the decisions.

- We like people who come to us with their own ideas. Our best team members tell

  us what we should be doing, they do not wait to be told.

- Start part time at 20 hours a week. If you are good and the workload grows,

  the hours and the rate grow with it.



WHAT WE DO NOT WANT



- Someone who needs to be taught what these platforms are.

- Someone who disappears for two days and then explains why.

- Agencies or teams applying on behalf of someone else. We want to hire a person.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your message with the word SCOOP in all caps. If you do not, we will

   not read the rest. This is our filter and we use it every time.

2. List which marketplace platforms you have actually worked on and what you did

   on each one. Be specific.

3. Tell us one real thing about yourself that has nothing to do with work.

4. Tell us what you think the biggest mistake is that most brands make on Faire

   or Amazon. There is no right answer. We want to see how you think.



Shortlisted candidates get a small paid test project before we hire. It takes

about an hour and we pay for your time either way.

title: Workflow Engineer - Automation Platform
description:
We are hiring a Workflow Engineer with a strong engineering mindset to build automation workflows end-to-end and help evolve our internal tooling — including contributing to our workflow builder AI.



This role is for someone who:

-thinks in logic, systems, and failure modes

-is comfortable reading and writing real code

-prefers correctness over shortcuts

-can work independently from clear specifications



This is not an IT support role, and not a low-code “automation specialist” position.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



-Core Engineering Work

-Build automation workflows end-to-end from structured tickets

Implement:

-triggers

-actions

-branching logic

-retries and idempotency

-failure handling and rollback logic

-Integrate with third-party APIs and internal services

-Write and reason about JavaScript-based workflow logic

-Test workflows against real-world edge cases

-Debug failed or partial executions

-Document assumptions and technical decisions clearly



Engineering Quality & Systems Thinking

-Identify incomplete or unsafe specifications before building

-Push back on unclear requirements instead of guessing

-Propose more robust or maintainable implementations

-Think about workflows as long-lived systems, not one-off builds

-Improve internal patterns, templates, and primitives



Platform & AI Tooling (Growing Responsibility)

-Contribute to improving our internal workflow builder

-Help define how automation logic is represented and validated

-Assist in training and shaping our AI-assisted workflow builder

-Provide engineering feedback on what should or should not be automated



This is a chance to influence how automation is built, not just build it.



What You Will NOT Do

-You will not provide end-user IT support

-You will not guess or “fill in gaps” in requirements

-You will not promise outcomes directly to clients

-You will not build fragile or untested automations



Reliability and correctness matter more than speed.



Required Experience & Skills



Must Have

-Strong engineering background

-Experience building production-grade systems, integrations, or automation

-JavaScript experience (strongly preferred)

-(used for workflow logic, conditions, transformations)

-Comfort working with:

-APIs (REST, authentication, pagination, rate limits)

-structured data (JSON)

-conditional logic and branching

-retries, idempotency, and error handling

-Ability to reason about edge cases and failure scenarios

-Strong written English for technical documentation and async communication



Strongly Preferred

-Experience with automation platforms or workflow engines

-Microsoft 365 / Entra ID experience

-MSP ecosystem familiarity

-Experience with PSA / RMM systems (ConnectWise, Halo, Ninja, Datto, etc.)

-Experience contributing to internal tools or developer platforms

-Experience working from detailed technical specs or tickets



What We’re Looking For

-Thinks like an engineer, not a technician

-Comfortable saying “this design is unsafe”

-Values clarity, correctness, and maintainability

-Calm, methodical problem solver

-Can work independently without constant supervision

-Enjoys building systems that other people rely on



How to Apply



 your application to: 



Please include:

-Your CV

-A GitHub profile or code samples

-(repositories, gists, or examples of real code you’ve written)

-A short technical write-up (bullet points are fine) covering:

-A system, integration, or automation you built

-The hardest technical problem you faced

-How you handled errors, retries, or edge cases

-Your expected monthly compensation in USD

title: Airbnb Operations and Video Editing
description:
# Virtual Assistant – Airbnb Operations and Video Editing



M3 Property Services is a growing serviced-accommodation and property-management company based in Kent, United Kingdom.



We manage multiple short-term and medium-term rental properties through Airbnb, Booking.com and direct bookings. We are looking for a reliable, proactive and highly organised Virtual Assistant to become a long-term member of our team.



This is not a standard fixed-hours position. The working hours will be flexible and spread across different parts of the day to support guests, cleaners and property operations during UK hours.



## Working arrangement



* Approximately six working hours per day.

* Hours will be distributed between the morning, afternoon and evening.

* You will not normally work six consecutive hours.

* You must be able to check the business at agreed times throughout the day.

* Some weekend availability will be required.

* You must respond quickly during your agreed coverage periods.

* The owner will provide cover during agreed gaps and outside your scheduled hours.

* Exact working times and days will be agreed with the successful applicant.

* Salary is negotiable depending on experience, availability and ability.



This position requires flexibility, but it does not mean being available every minute of the day. We want somebody reliable who can provide consistent coverage at the times when guests and operations require attention.



## Main responsibilities



### Guest communication and booking management



* Monitor and respond to Airbnb, Booking.com and direct-booking messages.

* Communicate with guests in clear, natural and professional English.

* Review the booking calendar several times throughout the day.

* Follow every guest through the complete booking journey.

* Monitor upcoming arrivals, guests currently staying and upcoming departures.

* Check that guests have received all required check-in, parking and property information.

* Follow up on missing guest details and unanswered questions.

* Handle straightforward guest questions independently.

* Recognise urgent problems and escalate them immediately.

* Keep booking information and guest records accurate.

* Assist with enquiries, availability checks and direct-booking quotes once trained.

* Help manage damage deposits and guest documentation once trained.



### Cleaning coordination



* Check the booking calendar every morning.

* Create and send the correct daily and upcoming cleaning schedules.

* Ensure cleaners know which properties require cleaning.

* Confirm that cleaning jobs have been accepted and completed.

* Follow up immediately if a cleaner has not responded.

* Record and report cleaning problems, damages and missing items.

* Keep future cleaning schedules accurate when bookings change.



### Maintenance and property administration



* Update and manage the maintenance tracker.

* Follow up with cleaners, contractors and maintenance workers.

* Ensure outstanding maintenance tasks are not forgotten.

* Record new property issues accurately.

* Keep property information, access instructions and operational documents updated.

* Escalate urgent maintenance problems immediately.

* Monitor and organise relevant company emails.

* Keep spreadsheets, calendars and trackers accurate.



### Financial and reporting support



Once trained, responsibilities may also include:



* Helping categorise property transactions.

* Updating property income and expense information.

* Assisting with monthly property profit-and-loss spreadsheets.

* Checking booking figures and property performance.

* Producing daily and weekly operational reports.

* Highlighting anything incomplete or requiring the owner’s attention.



### Video editing and content support



* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and other social platforms.

title: Ecommerce Funnel Builder | Funnelish and Shopify
description:
Please read the complete post before applying. This role is for an experienced ecommerce Funnel Builder who can handle both page execution and technical setup. It is not an entry-level design position.



Capital Heaven operates health, beauty, wellness and personal-care ecommerce brands across several international markets. We need someone who can take an approved source funnel, rebuild or localize it accurately, connect the correct products and offers, test the full customer journey and deliver it ready for launch.



You should be comfortable working independently from a written task while communicating clearly when information is missing or a technical issue could delay the launch.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



- Build, duplicate and localize ecommerce funnels in Funnelish.

- Create and update advertorials, sales pages, checkout pages, upsells and other required funnel steps.

- Review the complete task before starting and confirm the correct product, source funnel, store, market, language, currency, offer and deadline.

- Preserve the approved structure, angle and customer journey unless different instructions are provided.

- Update all market-specific copy, currencies, units, names, images, buttons, disclaimers and footer details.

- Create and configure Shopify products, variants, quantities, images, pricing, compare-at pricing, SKUs and URL paths.

- Connect every button and bundle option to the correct Shopify product and variant.

- Set up and check AfterSell flows when required.

- Configure domains, redirects, pixels, tracking and required events according to the company SOP.

- Work with WeTracked or similar ecommerce tracking tools.

- Test the full funnel on desktop and mobile, including page flow, buttons, bundles, shipping, checkout, payment options and tracking.

- Correct failed checks and retest the affected journey before submitting the funnel.

- Provide clear completion updates in ClickUp and Slack with live links, screenshots, test results and any remaining blockers.

- Coordinate with the product research, creative, media buying and Meta asset teams during handoffs.

- Stop and escalate when instructions conflict or when a product, offer, checkout path, domain or tracking setup cannot be verified.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



- Strong professional experience building ecommerce or dropshipping funnels.

- Hands-on experience using Funnelish for advertorials, sales pages, checkouts and upsells.

- Practical Shopify experience, including products, variants, pricing, SKUs, bundle connections and checkout paths.

- Experience duplicating or localizing proven funnels for different stores, countries, languages and currencies.

- Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile funnel testing.

- Ability to troubleshoot broken buttons, incorrect variants, checkout problems, domain issues, redirects and tracking errors.

- Experience with Meta Pixel, events and ecommerce tracking tools.

- Strong attention to product codes, prices, offers, currencies, markets and technical details.

- Ability to follow SOPs and detailed written instructions without skipping QA steps.

- Clear written English and reliable communication through Slack and ClickUp.

- Ability to manage several assigned funnels and meet deadlines without sacrificing accuracy.

- Full-time and long-term availability.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- Experience with AfterSell, WeTracked, Meta Pixel, Google Sheets and Google Drive.

- Experience with health, beauty, wellness, supplement or personal-care products.

- Familiarity with direct-response advertorials, bundles, upsells and conversion-focused page structures.

- Experience supporting several ecommerce stores and international markets.

- Previous experience training or reviewing other funnel builders.



QUALITY AND COMPLIANCE



Accuracy is more important than rushing a funnel live.



You must request clarification when the approved source, product, store, market, language, currency, price, offer, shipping, checkout, tracking or deadline is missing or conflicting.



You must also flag unsupported medical claims, guaranteed results, misleading before-and-after content, unapproved testimonials or endorsements, excessive discounts, wrong-market references and incorrect technical routing.



Never edit a live winning source funnel directly. Do not place a real order during testing.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



This opening is for a Funnel Builder. A highly experienced employee who consistently demonstrates strong technical ability, ownership, quality control and leadership may later be trained for a Funnel Manager position.



WHAT WE OFFER



- A stable, long-term remote position.

- Full-time work across several ecommerce brands and markets.

- Clear SOPs, checklists and task-based workflows.

- Exposure to funnel production, localization, checkout setup, tracking and launch coordination.

- Compensation based on demonstrated experience and skill level.

- A possible future growth path for someone who performs consistently and can support the wider funnel team.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word FUNNEL to confirm that you read the complete post.



Answer all questions below. Give specific examples instead of general statements.



1. How many years of professional funnel-building experience do you have, and how much of that work was for ecommerce or dropshipping brands?

2. Describe your hands-on Funnelish experience. Which funnel pages and technical setups have you completed yourself?

3. Describe your Shopify experience with products, variants, quantities, SKUs, pricing, checkout links and bundles.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Your main responsibility will be creating static image ads for
 and Instagram. Strong swipe-research experience is highly preferred because we want someone who can identify promising concepts and turn them into original ad variations, rather than waiting for every idea to be provided.



You will work closely with a Creative Strategist and receive feedback based on creative testing, media-buying results, and Meta compliance.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Create static image ads for ecommerce products across health, beauty, wellness, and personal-care categories.

- Research competitor ads using the Meta Ad Library and other approved sources.

- Identify strong hooks, angles, offers, layouts, audience problems, and visual concepts.

- Evaluate swipes using available evidence such as reach, run duration, repeated concepts, active creative volume, market relevance, and product fit.

- Turn approved swipes and creative briefs into original ads without directly copying competitors.

- Create variations using different hooks, angles, offers, layouts, and visual approaches.

- Produce advertorial, testimonial, product-benefit, comparison, offer, and problem-solution ads.

- Use AI tools when appropriate to create or improve product scenes, backgrounds, models, and other creative elements.

- Correct AI-generated problems involving hands, faces, text, labels, lighting, shadows, and product accuracy.

- Follow every brief carefully and confirm the correct product, market, offer, copy, and claims before submission.

- Organize source links, swipe references, working files, and final creatives clearly.

- Revise ads based on strategist feedback, performance results, and rejected-ad learnings.

- Flag risky health claims, misleading visuals, or unclear instructions before proceeding.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven experience creating static Meta ads for ecommerce, dropshipping, or DTC brands.

- A portfolio containing relevant ecommerce image ads.

- Strong direct-response design skills, including visual hierarchy, typography, readability, layout, and product presentation.

- Experience using the Meta Ad Library and researching competitor ads.

- Ability to explain why a swipe may be working based on evidence, not only appearance.

- Ability to preserve the core idea behind a swipe while creating an original ad.

- Proficiency in Canva and Photoshop. Figma experience is a plus.

- Practical experience with AI image-generation or editing tools is preferred.

- Strong attention to product names, labels, offers, markets, claims, and brief requirements.

- Reliable communication and the ability to complete revisions professionally.

- Full-time, long-term availability.

- Weekend availability when required.



META COMPLIANCE EXPECTATIONS



You must recognize and avoid risky elements such as:



- Cure, treatment, or medical claims.

- Guaranteed results.

- Unrealistic timelines.

- Misleading before-and-after concepts.

- Aggressive personal-attribute language.

- Unsupported authority or doctor claims.

- Celebrity or television-personality lookalikes.

- Offers or discounts that do not match the approved brief.



If a brief or swipe contains a risky claim or visual, stop and ask the Creative Strategist for clarification before creating or submitting the ad.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word SWIPE.



Answer all questions below. General applications that do not answer the questions will not be prioritized.



1. How many years have you created static image ads for ecommerce, dropshipping, or DTC brands?

2. Which health, beauty, wellness, supplement, or personal-care products have you worked on?

3. Walk us through how you find strong competitor ads using the Meta Ad Library or other sources.

4. What evidence do you use to d
 whether a swipe or concept is worth testing?

5. Share one example of a competitor swipe and the original ad you created from it. Explain what you changed.

6. How do you preserve the main reason a swipe works without copying the competitor directly?

7. Which design and AI tools do you use?

8. Describe one ad where you used AI. Explain what you generated and what you corrected manually.

9. How many high-quality static-ad variations can you normally produce per day?

title: E-commerce Ad Creative Specialist & Video Editor
description:
We are an e-commerce company managing multiple online stores and products, primarily targeting the Italian market.



We are looking for a talented E-commerce Ad Creative Specialist & Video Editor to join us on a long-term, full-time basis.



This is NOT just a traditional video editing position.



We are looking for someone who understands that the purpose of an ad creative is to generate attention, engagement and SALES.



Your main responsibility will be creating high-performing video and static ad creatives for
 and Instagram (Meta Ads).



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create short-form video ads for e-commerce products.

• Create static image ads for
 and Instagram.

• Develop strong hooks, especially within the first 1–3 seconds.

• Research new creative concepts and marketing angles for each product.

• Turn existing product photos, videos and raw footage into compelling advertisements.

• Create different variations of winning creatives.

• Test different hooks, angles, headlines, offers and CTAs.

• Create UGC-style ads.

• Create Problem/Solution ads.

• Create Product Demonstration ads.

• Create Storytelling ads.

• Create Offer-Based ads.

• Add subtitles, headlines and on-screen text.

• Find appropriate stock footage or additional content when needed.

• Research competitors and successful e-commerce advertisements for inspiration.

• Continuously bring new creative ideas instead of simply waiting for instructions.

• Adapt successful creatives into multiple new variations.



You should understand Direct Response advertising and how to structure an ad using principles such as:



HOOK

→ RETENTION

→ PROBLEM / DESIRE

→ PRODUCT

→ BENEFITS

→ PROOF

→ OFFER

→ CALL TO ACTION



We are not looking for someone who only makes visually attractive videos.



We want someone who understands WHY people stop scrolling, WHY they continue watching and WHY they eventually purchase a product.



REQUIREMENTS



• Strong video editing skills.

• Experience creating e-commerce advertisements.

• Good understanding of Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising creatives.

• Understanding of Direct Response Marketing.

• Strong creative thinking.

• Ability to develop hooks and marketing angles.

• Ability to create static ad designs.

• Good understanding of pacing, music, captions, transitions and visual storytelling.

• Ability to work independently.

• Reliable communication.

• Good attention to detail.

• Ability to consistently produce creatives every week.



Experience with tools such as:



• Adobe Premiere Pro

• After Effects

• CapCut

• Photoshop

• Canva

• Illustrator

• AI creative tools



is welcome.



The specific software you use is less important than the quality of your final work.



ITALIAN LANGUAGE



Most of our products target customers in Italy.



Speaking Italian is a plus but NOT mandatory. We can provide Italian scripts, translations and copy when necessary.



LONG-TERM POSITION



This is not a one-time project.



We manage multiple products and online stores and continuously need new advertising creatives.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our e-commerce team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. Links to your 5 best e-commerce video ads.

2. Examples of static ad creatives you have created.

3. Explain exactly what you did on those ads (editing only, script, hook, creative concept, etc.).

4. Which editing/design tools you use.

5. Your experience with e-commerce and Meta Ads.

6. How many video creatives you can realistically create per week.

7. How many static creatives you can create per week.

8. Your expected monthly salary.

9. Your availability and current working schedule.



IMPORTANT:



Please do not send a generic portfolio containing only logos, branding or regular social-media posts.



We specifically want to see E-COMMERCE AD CREATIVES.



We value creativity, marketing thinking and performance more than fancy transitions.

title: AI Video Creator — ComfyUI + Character Consistency (Short-Form Reels)
description:
We run a faceless short-form video channel on Instagram and TikTok built around

one recurring AI character — an elderly woman who gives simple health advice.

We post 5-7 videos a week, 45-90 seconds each.



We give you the script and the master character images. You build the rest.



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- The finished script for each video

- The recorded voiceover file

- The master character sheet: her face, her clothing, her hands, her locations

- Brand guidelines: caption style, pacing, what the channel does and does not do

- Server access and paid tool accounts. You pay for nothing.



WHAT YOU BUILD

- Decide the shots. Read the script and work out what the viewer should see.

- Write your own image prompts and generate every shot from the master sheet,

  keeping the character identical across every video we have ever posted

- Build and maintain the ComfyUI workflows for image generation, animation and

  lip-sync

- Animate the shots and run the lip-sync against our voice file

- Edit in CapCut or your editor of choice: cuts, burned-in karaoke captions,

  pinned banner, audio mix

- Export vertical 1080x1920 and post it

- Keep clean, organised folders so any asset from any video can be found later



REQUIRED

- ComfyUI. Not "I have seen it." You build and modify your own workflows,

  install custom nodes, and fix a broken graph without asking.

- Real experience keeping ONE character consistent across many generations.

  This is the whole job. If her face drifts between videos, the channel dies.

- AI video generation: WAN, Hailuo/MiniMax, Kling, Runway, Veo — any of them

- Lip-sync tools: InfiniteTalk, Hedra, Sync.so, Kling Avatar, LatentSync

- Strong short-form editing, especially burned-in captions and audio timing

- You can write your own prompts in English and explain why a generation failed

- Reliable internet, your own computer, and hours overlapping Europe (CET)



NICE TO HAVE

- LoRA training

- Instagram Reels / TikTok posting and scheduling experience

- Photography or cinematography background



THE PART THAT MATTERS MOST

These tools fail constantly. Hands come out wrong. The character freezes. The

lip-sync smears. The model ignores half your prompt.



We are not looking for someone who sends the first output and calls it done. We

are looking for someone who sees what is wrong, knows why, changes one thing,

and runs it again. That instinct is worth more to us than any tool on your CV.



You will own this end to end. We will give you honest feedback and we expect the

same back.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word GINGER so we know you read this.



Then answer:

1. How do you keep one character's face consistent across dozens of

   generations? Name the actual nodes, models or method you use.

2. Send links to two short vertical videos you made with AI tools — ideally

   with the same character in both.

3. Describe one time an AI generation kept coming out wrong and what you

   changed to fix it.



Applications without the word GINGER will not be read.

title: Real Estate Dispositions Coordinator Needed to Sell 20+ Houses Per Month!
description:
Dispositions Coordinator — Real Estate



Are you the person who follows a process every single day and never lets important follow-ups fall through the cracks?



Are you persistent, highly organized, resourceful, and comfortable holding people accountable to deadlines?



We’re a growing real estate investment company looking for a Dispositions Coordinator to manage our property pipeline, build buyer and JV relationships, and help move every deal successfully from contract to close.



This is not a high-pressure sales role.



This is a process, follow-up, communication, research, and execution role.



Most buyer communication happens through text and
, but you must also be confident picking up the phone when a conversation, deadline, or problem requires it.



You'll have a clear daily process to follow. We're looking for someone who executes that process consistently, keeps everything organized, follows up relentlessly, and takes ownership without needing to be reminded.



What You'll Own



Property Dispositions



* Market properties immediately after photos and property information are received

* Send
 blasts, texts, and other buyer communications for every new property

* Follow our daily marketing and follow-up process consistently

* Follow up with interested buyers until you receive a clear answer

* Schedule buyer walkthroughs and coordinate access with our transactions team

* Follow up immediately after walkthroughs for feedback and offers

* Track buyer activity, offers, property status, and next steps accurately in Podio

* Coordinate closely with our transactions team until every deal successfully closes



If a property isn't selling, you don't simply wait.



You follow the process, increase follow-up, research additional buyers, try new approaches, and communicate what you're seeing to the team.



Buyer Follow-Up & Accountability



Getting a buyer to commit to a property isn't the finish line. We need every deal to actually close.



* Stay on top of buyers after they commit to a property

* Ensure contracts, signatures, deposits, and other deadlines are completed on time

* Follow up persistently when something is outstanding

* Be friendly but firm when buyers aren't meeting agreed-upon deadlines

* Pick up the phone when text or
 isn't getting the job done

* Verify buyer funding and ability to close

* Identify potential issues early and communicate them immediately

* Maintain accurate buyer notes and profiles in Podio

* Build strong relationships with reliable buyers



You should be comfortable sending the second, third, or fourth follow-up when necessary.



We are always respectful, but we don't allow important deadlines to drift because we're afraid to follow up.



Build Our Buyer Network



One of the most important parts of this role is continually expanding our network.



We want someone who naturally asks:



"Who else could buy this property?"



* Add a minimum of 10 new qualified buyers or real estate professionals to our database every day

* Research active cash buyers, investors, landlords, flippers, builders, agents, and other potential buyers

* Use online research, public records, social media, networking, and other creative methods to uncover new relationships

* Research who is actively purchasing similar properties in our markets

* Maintain and improve our VIP buyer list

* Keep buyer profiles accurate and useful

* Build genuine relationships with buyers instead of simply collecting contact information



We're looking for someone with a knack for research and thinking outside the box.



If one approach doesn't work, you should naturally want to find another.



Build JV Partner Relationships



We also want this person constantly expanding our network of wholesalers and other real estate professionals who have deals we can help sell.



* Continually identify and reach out to new potential JV partners

* Build relationships with wholesalers, investors, agents, and other deal sources in our markets

* Research active wholesalers and investment companies we aren't currently working with

* Introduce our company and explain how we can help them successfully disposition their properties

* Follow up consistently with potential JV partners instead of contacting them once and forgetting about them

* Maintain relationships with existing JV partners so they continue bringing us opportunities

* Track JV conversations, relationships, opportunities, and follow-ups in our CRM

* Look for creative new ways to find wholesalers and partners with deals we can help sell

* Consistently work toward bringing new JV opportunities into our pipeline



The goal isn't simply to maintain the relationships we already have. We want someone who is continually creating new relationships that can produce more deals for the company.



Follow the Process — Every Day



This may be the most important part of the job.



We have systems and processes that work. We need someone who follows them consistently without needing to be chased.



* Follow the daily dispositions checklist and workflow

* Complete every scheduled buyer and JV follow-up

* Update Podio after every meaningful interaction

* Keep every active property's status and next action current

* Respond quickly to messages, calls, and
s during business hours

* Submit an accurate EOD report every day

* Track offers received, properties sold, days to sell, deposits received, new buyers added, and JV activity

* Communicate problems early instead of waiting until they become emergencies



You won't need someone to create your to-do list every morning. The process already exists. Your job is to execute it exceptionally well.



You're the Right Fit If You



* Are extremely organized and process-driven

* Follow checklists and systems consistently without being reminded

* Are persistent with follow-up

* Communicate clearly and professionally through text,
, and phone

* Are comfortable picking up the phone when necessary

* Can be firm without being rude

* Don't feel uncomfortable following up multiple times when something is outstanding

* Keep your CRM clean and accurate

* Take ownership instead of waiting for instructions

* Love researching and figuring things out

* Enjoy finding and developing new relationships

* Naturally look for alternative solutions when the obvious answer isn't working

* Can manage multiple active deals and deadlines simultaneously

* Communicate proactively without leadership having to chase you

* Move with urgency while still paying attention to details

* Have experience in real estate, wholesaling, dispositions, coordination, customer service, or operations

* Are available Monday–Friday during EST business hours



You Are NOT the Right Fit If You



* Need constant direction to know what to do next

* Follow a process for a few days and then stop

* Send one follow-up and consider your job done

* Are afraid to hold someone accountable to a deadline

* Avoid phone conversations even when a call would solve the problem faster

* Skip CRM updates or treat reporting as optional

* Wait for someone else to solve problems

* Struggle to research and find information independently

* Aren't comfortable proactively reaching out and developing new relationships

* Get overwhelmed managing multiple priorities at once

What This Role Looks Like

**Hours:** 8 hours per day, Monday through Friday

**Output expectation:**

- 1 video per day if the project is a long-form VSL (up to 5 minutes)

You will produce
 ad creative across multiple formats. You will have a clear brief, organized assets, and a team behind you. What we need from you is execution at the highest level.



What You Will Create



- Direct-response video ads built to drive purchases

- UGC-style ads that feel authentic, not produced

- AI-generated B-roll that supports the script without looking artificial

- Motion-graphics ads with clean visual hierarchy

- Hook variations and creative iterations

- Testimonial, review-style, and listicle ads

Direct-Response Editing

You understand what makes someone stop scrolling and what makes them buy. You can turn a script and a brief into a complete, conversion-focused ad. You know how to build a hook, carry tension through the video, and close with a call to action that actually converts.



UGC Editing

You can take raw creator footage and make it feel effortless. You know when to cut, when to leave imperfections in, and how to improve weak delivery without making the creator sound edited.



AI Video Production

You can use AI tools to generate or enhance spokesperson footage, voice-overs, and B-roll. You know how to catch the glitches, correct unnatural pacing, and produce an end result that does not feel artificial.



Motion Graphics and Sound Design

You can animate text, benefits, reviews, and offers in ways that aid clarity. You understand audio balancing, music selection, and how sound design affects retention.



Organization and Communication

You manage your own workload. You know what is due and when. You communicate blockers before they become problems. You submit clean, organized project files every time.



  Required Experience



- Professional video editing experience (senior level)

- Direct experience creating
 ad creative for 
 
 brands

- Experience editing UGC advertisements

- Experience producing or enhancing AI video content

- Strong motion-graphics skills (not just templates)

- Proficiency in at least one professional editing suite:

  - Adobe Premiere Pro

  - Adobe After Effects

  - Final Cut Pro

**Preferred tools and platforms:** ( ALL TOOLS PROVIDED )

Kling, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Gemini, ChatGPT, Google Drive, Slack, Meta Ad Library



    Compensation



Base: $1,500–$2,000 USD per month depending on experience, speed, quality, and communication



Performance Bonus: 0.5% of ad spend on your top 5 performing ads each month, paid after the month closes



Our top editors earn **$5,000–$7,000 per month** when base and performance bonuses are combined. That ceiling is real. We have editors hitting it.



How to Apply



**Applications are accepted by email only.**



Send your complete application to: **[jessicahiringmanager1
.com]**



Use the subject line: **Senior Video Editor Application – Your Full Name**



Everything must be in one email. Applications missing any component below will not be reviewed. Generic, copy-paste, or fully AI-written applications that do not address your specific experience will not be considered.



---



## Application Questions



Answer every question directly in the body of your email.



**1. Experience**

How many years of professional video editing experience do you have? How much of that has been direct-response or DTC eCommerce work specifically?



**2. Output and Workload**

How many video ads did you edit in the last 90 days? How many brands or clients were you managing at the same time?



**3. Tools**

List every editing, motion-graphics, AI-video, voice-generation, and image-generation tool you actively use. Which one are you strongest in and why?



**4. AI Video**

Walk us through your process for producing an AI spokesperson video. How do you make the voice, face, and B-roll look and sound natural? What do you check before you submit?



**5. Performance and Judgment**

Tell us about a specific ad you edited that performed well or failed. What happened? What do you think caused the result? What did you take away from it?



**6. Handling a Weak Brief**

What do you do when the brief you receive is incomplete or the assets provided are not strong enough to build a good ad? Walk us through exactly what you do.



**7. Communication**

Rate your written and spoken English from 1–10 and explain your rating honestly. Are you comfortable communicating via Slack, video calls, and Loom?



**8. Availability**

What country and time zone are you in? Can you work 9-5 EST? When can you start, and do you have any current commitments we should know about?



**9. Compensation and Long-Term Fit**

What base monthly rate are you seeking?  What would you need to see from us to stay for two or more years?  Why do you want to work here specifically?



10- Commitment

Do you have any other commitments that you would need to address first? Be honest



---



## Required Work Examples



Do not send your full portfolio. Do not link a general Drive folder. Do not send work that is unrelated to this role.



Send only the following:



- **Two UGC advertisements**

- **Two direct-response advertisements**

- **One motion-graphics example**

For each example, clearly explain:

- What you personally edited, animated, or created

- What stock footage, templates, or assets came from elsewhere

- What, if anything, was completed by another person



Applications that send a general portfolio instead of these specific examples will not be reviewed.



---



## Required Loom Video



Record a Loom video under five minutes, specifically for this application.



Do not send a generic introduction you have recorded for other jobs.



In your Loom:

- Introduce yourself

- Explain why you are applying to this specific brand and role

Include the Loom link in the body of your application email.

We are seeking a Virtual Assistant Property Manager to join our team and help manage our property portfolio. This is a long-term, full-time role in a supportive, caring and respectful environment for someone who is highly organized, proactive, and fluent in English.



We currently have a significant backlog to clear, so you must be a quick learner able to get up to speed fast and hit the ground running.



~~~

Responsibilities:

-Work remotely via a connected machine, Monday to Friday, 8am–6pm UK time (must be contactable outside those hours in case of emergencies).

-Stay on top of enquiries and deal with them promptly — nothing sits unanswered.

-Liaise between landlords and tenants on maintenance, repairs, and general property matters, by phone and in writing.

-Answer incoming phone calls to the agency, handle queries directly where possible, and pass on messages to the sales/lettings team where necessary.

-Keep our CRM system (Microsoft Teams/Lists) fully up to date at all times — this includes updating property, landlord, tenant, contractor, compliance, maintenance, and key records as work progresses, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

-Progress maintenance and repair jobs from reported issue through to completion, keeping all parties informed at each stage.

-Book contractors and source tradespeople for repairs and maintenance work.

-Get multiple quotes for each job to ensure landlords receive good value for money, and keep a clear record of comparisons.

-Coordinate ordering of spare parts where needed.

-Assist with legal matters by liaising with lawyers, insurance companies, and other professionals as required.

-Collaborate with the directors to improve and implement organizational systems and processes.

-Keep things moving — proactively chase outstanding items rather than waiting to be asked.



~~~

Requirements

-Reliable internet (minimum 20mbps download, 10mbps upload) and uninterrupted power.

-Exceptional written and spoken English skills.

-Highly independent and capable of managing tasks with minimal supervision.

-Strong organizational skills and the ability to stay on top of a busy, varied workload.

-A fast learner — we have a considerable backlog to clear and need someone who can get up to speed quickly.

-Immediate availability to start and complete a brief trial period to gauge fit.

-Interest in a long-term, full-time commitment to grow with the company.

-Experience with property or real estate management is beneficial but not essential; experience in similar construction or building-type industries is also welcome.



As part of your application, please send your CV and also record a short video answering the following questions:



1. What is your experience with property management (or a related industry)?

2. How do you make sure we get the best value for money for our landlords?

3. How familiar are you with using AI for work?

4. How efficiently do you work in general?



To Apply:

Please
 a copy of your CV and your introduction video (specific to this role) directly to: 



*IMPORTANT: If you do not send this directly to the above
 address, your application will not be received!*



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: AI Video Editor
description:
OVERVIEW



I'm building a strong AI content team and looking for experienced creators who can consistently produce realistic, high-quality short-form videos at scale. 



I'm building a portfolio of AI character accounts promoting health supplements on Instagram and
. US-based, and I run this like a real company: signed contracts, documented SOPs, a Google Sheet/Drive production pipeline, weekly Wise payments that have never been late, and written feedback every single workday. If you've been ghosted, underpaid, or left guessing by past clients, this is the opposite.

You won't be working alone. There's a 
 server where the team shares strategies, troubleshoots generations, talks about new tools, and posts when a video goes viral. People here help each other instead of competing. I'm active in it daily, not a client who disappears for a week.



THE BAR



This role is for someone who already generates AI video at a high level. You will be given one of our existing videos and asked to recreate it. If you can match the realism, character consistency, pacing, and overall quality of the reference, we'll move forward. If you're still learning these tools, this isn't the right post for you, and I'd rather save you the time.

The recreation assignment will be paid at a lower rate than normal production work.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Produce short-form videos start to finish:

_ Generate the character frame in Nano Banana Pro

_ Animate in Veo 3.1 / Omni Flash via Google Flow

_ Write prompts with ChatGPT or Claude

_ Edit in CapCut: captions, pacing, transitions, on-screen text

_ Deliver to Google Drive and log in Google Sheets

_ Minimum of 15 videos per week

There is no hard maximum. We can agree on a realistic weekly output based on how many videos you can consistently produce while maintaining quality. If you can reliably produce more, more work is available.

This is not traditional editing. There is no raw footage. You are generating everything from scratch.

Reference video for expected quality:





REQUIREMENTS



Strong experience producing AI-generated video

Portfolio of work YOU personally made

Strong written English

Available 5 days per week

Wise account for payment

Experience required: Nano Banana Pro, Veo 3.1 / Google Flow, CapCut, Claude or ChatGPT



COMPENSATION



$4.50 per approved video, paid weekly via Wise.

Uncapped performance bonuses when videos perform well, generally ranging from $5 to $50 per video depending on performance. The full bonus structure will be discussed in greater detail after the application process.

Taking on additional responsibilities may also come with additional compensation, separate from the per-video rate.



HOW TO APPLY



Title your application AI Video Editor — [Your Name] so I know you read this.

In your application, only answer the questions below. Do not add anything else.

1- Links to 3 AI videos you personally created.

2- A 2-minute Loom screen recording walking me through how you made one of those videos and explaining your overall workflow. Open the actual project and show your generation history, original AI generations, and editing timeline so I can verify the work is yours.

3-In one sentence, tell me the hardest character consistency problem you've solved and how you solved it.

Applications without the items listed above will not be reviewed.

Strong applicants get a paid recreation assignment before onboarding. Software costs will be covered.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Part-Time UK Land & Property Sourcer / Researcher
description:
Part-Time UK Land & Property Sourcer



We are looking for a Part-Time UK Land & Property Sourcer to help identify suitable land, property, development and investment opportunities across the UK.



This role is focused on UK land and property sourcing only, so applicants should have a genuine interest in UK property, development sites, auction properties and investment opportunities.



Full training will be provided, but the ideal candidate must be naturally curious, detail-focused and willing to carry out proper research.



Role Overview



You will be responsible for carrying out detailed online research to find land and property opportunities that match our criteria.



This will involve many hours of structured research using Google Maps, Street View, UK property portals, auction websites, commercial property sites, planning portals and other online sources.



A big part of the role involves detective-style research — following clues, checking surrounding areas, spotting underused sites, reviewing planning history, identifying ownership clues and piecing together information from a range of different sources.



Key Responsibilities

Source UK land and property opportunities suitable for acquisition, investment or development.

Research opportunities using Google Maps, Street View and satellite view.

Search UK property portals including Rightmove, Zoopla, OnTheMarket and commercial property websites.

Review UK auction sites and upcoming auction catalogues.

Research planning portals to check site history and possible development potential.

Look for vacant land, unused buildings, garages, yards, commercial sites and redevelopment opportunities.

Carry out detective-style research from multiple sources to find overlooked or under-marketed opportunities.

Prepare clear shortlists with links, asking prices, location details, planning notes and comments.

Track leads clearly in a spreadsheet or CRM-style format.

Provide regular updates on new opportunities found.

Requirements

UK land or property sourcing experience preferred.

Familiarity with Rightmove, Zoopla, auction sites and Google Maps.

Comfortable doing detailed online research for long periods.

Strong attention to detail.

Able to spot potential opportunities others may miss.

Good written English and clear reporting.

Proactive, organised and able to work independently.

Must be serious, reliable and willing to learn.

Training



Full training will be provided on our specific sourcing criteria, research methods and reporting format.



However, applicants should already be confident using the internet for research and should have either direct UK property experience or a strong interest in UK land and property sourcing.



Hours & Pay

Around 12 hours per week

Part-time and remote

Pay: $3–$4 per hour, depending on experience

Ongoing work available for the right person

Important



This is not a simple data-entry role. It requires patience, curiosity and proper research. We are looking for someone who can investigate opportunities carefully and think like a detective.



When applying, please include any experience you have with UK property, land sourcing, auction research, planning research, Google Maps research or online lead generation.

title: Experienced M&A Deal Sourcer - Minimum 3 years experiences in prospecting and creating a M&A pipeline

Position: Experienced M&A Deal Sourcer / Research Analyst

Location: Remote (UK preferred)

Type: Part-Time to Full-Time Progression

Salary: Competitive, based on experience



About Us



We are an ambitious investment and acquisitions group with a strong focus on growth through strategic business acquisitions. Our goal is to complete up to five acquisitions per year across selected industries, building a sustainable and scalable M&A division to support long-term expansion.



We are now seeking an experienced M&A Deal Sourcer who can help us identify, qualify, and manage acquisition opportunities in the UK SME and lower mid-market space.



The Role



You’ll be responsible for creating and managing the full M&A sourcing pipeline — from market research and target identification to broker engagement and initial outreach. This is a high-impact position for someone with a deep understanding of deal origination and a hunger to build a growing acquisitions arm within an expanding group.



Key Responsibilities:



Research the market / web and identify suitable acquisition targets across defined sectors.



Develop detailed acquisition search criteria and sourcing strategies.



Build and maintain strong relationships with business brokers, corporate advisors, and owners.



Create and manage an active M&A pipeline within CRM systems.



Conduct outreach via email, LinkedIn, and phone to generate and qualify leads.



Prepare initial summaries and deal overviews for internal review.



Support senior management during the early stages of due diligence and analysis.



Requirements



Minimum 3 years’ experience in M&A sourcing, deal origination, or acquisition research (essential).



Strong understanding of the M&A process — from research through to initial negotiation.



UK market experience preferred, though international (US or EU) experience also valued.



Proven success building and managing broker and intermediary networks.



Confident using CRMs, databases, and research platforms to manage deal flow.



Excellent communication skills and attention to detail.



Ambitious, driven, and passionate about growing a division from the ground up.



Why Join Us



Work directly with senior leadership in a fast-growing acquisitions team.



Opportunity to grow into a senior, full-time leadership position heading up the M&A division.



Real progression, autonomy, and the ability to shape long-term acquisition strategy.



How to Apply

title: Human Resources for Nonprofit
description:
We’re looking for an experienced HR Operations & Staff Management Specialist to help us build a healthy, accountable, and well-organized workplace. 



This is a focused role for someone whose strengths are people management, operational systems, and policy administration. We already have payroll covered. The position may be part-time or full-time, depending on the right fit.



Your primary responsibility will be helping our staff feel supported while ensuring they meet the expectations of their roles. You’ll hold regular staff check-ins, listen to concerns, clarify responsibilities and goals, and follow up on commitments. 



Working alongside the director, you’ll help identify obstacles, address performance concerns, and ensure that each person is contributing consistently.



You’ll also keep our HR policies and staff records organized, current, and consistently applied. This includes managing time-off requests, documenting sick leave, tracking attendance and agreed working hours—including our standard 40-hour workweek for full-time staff—and making sure everyone understands the relevant procedures. You should bring substantial hands-on experience in HR operations and staff management, with a proven ability to improve systems. You’ll first learn the processes we already use, then strengthen them and develop practical solutions where gaps exist. We’re looking for maturity, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to have difficult conversations with both empathy and firmness. You should be a patient listener who makes people feel heard while communicating expectations clearly and holding people accountable.



You need to be extremely organized and also highly proficient in problem solving. HR will be your focus, but we would expect your input in our general operations as well alongside our Director of Operations. 



Our goal is a deeply healthy culture where people have internal clarity about their responsibilities, expectations, and where to turn for support—and can perform their work effectively. The director will remain involved in performance and professional development; you’ll bring additional structure, care, and consistency to the staff experience. 



To apply, share relevant experience, an example of a people-management system you improved, and your availability for part-time or full-time freelance work. Use the exact application title “High Noon HR” so we know you’ve read the entire post.

title: Creative Director / Content Strategist — Full-Time
description:
About the Role



I'm looking for a Creative Director / Content Strategist to work directly with me and help take my personal brand and content to the next level.



I'm not looking for someone who just comes up with random content ideas or focuses on getting views.



I want someone who understands how to create high-converting content that builds authority, grows a brand, generates leads, and ultimately drives revenue.



This is a long-term position. My goal is to find someone who learns my voice, understands the way I speak and think, understands my audience, and eventually becomes someone I can trust to help lead the creative direction of my brand.



What You'll Be Responsible For



You'll help manage the entire strategy behind my content, including:



Researching my market, audience, trends, and competitors

Identifying what's currently working and what's not

Developing new content angles and ideas

Writing short-form video scripts in my voice

Developing direct-response and organic content

Creating concepts and scripts for paid ads

Writing hooks, CTAs, captions, and supporting copy

Planning content around specific business and brand objectives

Posting and managing content across platforms

Reviewing content performance and using the data to improve future content

Continuously finding ways to improve my positioning, messaging, authority, and overall brand



You should be able to look at my existing content and say:



"Here's what's working. Here's what's weak. Here's what we should test next. And here's exactly how I'd execute it."



Who I'm Looking For



You should have experience with content strategy, copywriting, direct response, personal brands, or social media marketing.



You need to understand the difference between content that simply gets attention and content that actually moves an audience toward taking action.



I'm specifically looking for someone who:



Understands high-converting short-form content

Is a strong copywriter and storyteller

Can write natural scripts that don't sound generic or AI-generated

Understands hooks, retention, CTAs, offers, and buyer psychology

Can study someone's existing voice and write content that sounds like them

Understands organic content AND paid advertising

Is comfortable doing deep competitor and market research

Is proactive and brings ideas instead of waiting for instructions

Pays close attention to analytics and performance

Wants to grow into a bigger role over time

Compensation & Growth



The starting rate for this position is $400 USD/month.



During the first 30 days, I'll be evaluating the quality of your work, creativity, communication, consistency, and the results of the content we're producing.



Based on performance, compensation can increase after the first 30 days and continue increasing as you take on more responsibility and produce results.



I'm not looking to hire someone for a few weeks or months. I'm looking for someone I can potentially work with for years and grow alongside the brand.



How to Apply



Before applying, please study my content:



Instagram: 

YouTube: 



Don't send me a generic application.



After reviewing my content, please send me:



A short audit of my current content. Tell me what you think I'm doing well, what you think could be improved, and what opportunities you see that I'm currently missing.

Write 1–2 short-form video scripts for me. These should be actual pieces of content you believe I should create based on my brand, audience, personality, business, and current content.

Tell me about your experience. What brands, creators, or businesses have you worked with? What exactly were you responsible for? Include examples of your work and any results you've helped generate.

Tell me why you think you'd be a good fit for this role.



I'm going to pay close attention to the application because the quality of your audit and the scripts you create will be one of the biggest factors in d
 who moves forward.



I'm looking for someone who doesn't just want another freelance gig.



I'm looking for someone who wants to become deeply involved in a brand, understand the vision, continuously sharpen the content, and help us build something much bigger over the long term.
