title: The Sales Position Hungry Closers Have Been Looking For - Up to $1,900/Month
description:
The sales position hungry closers have been looking for.



If you know how to turn warm interest into booked appointments and paid deposits, this role pays you like a professional. Astolia offers a strong full-time base of $8 USD per hour, plus $2 for every $29 deposit you close. You will work warm US med-spa leads, use a clear script and our in-house CRM, and earn more as your results grow.



ABOUT ASTOLIA

Astolia is a US-based med-spa brand offering aesthetic treatments through a growing network of clinics. Our clients come to us through online offers and Meta ads. Our phone sales team is the first human voice they hear.



We are building a small, dedicated, high-performing remote sales team. This is not a batch hiring process, and you will not be placed in a pool. We are looking for proven phone sales professionals who want a stable full-time role, clear targets, real coaching, and uncapped commission.



THE ROLE

You will call warm inbound leads who have already shown interest in Astolia's offer. Your job is to qualify each lead, answer questions, handle objections, and book the right prospects into a consultation with a $29 deposit.



We provide the warm leads, script, in-house CRM, clear targets, coaching, and feedback. You bring the voice, energy, discipline, and sales judgment.



Most of your workday will be spent on the phone. You must be comfortable hearing "no," staying positive, following up consistently, and closing the prospects who are ready.



This is a full-time, remote role working Monday through Friday during US Eastern business hours. For applicants in the Philippines, this is a permanent night-shift position.



COMPENSATION: TRANSPARENT BASE + UNCAPPED COMMISSION

- $8 USD per hour for 40 hours per week

- Approximately $1,387 USD per month in base pay

- Plus $2 USD for every $29 deposit you close

- Commission is uncapped



What that can look like over an average month:

- 3 deposits per workday: approximately $1,517/month total

- 4 deposits per workday: approximately $1,560/month total

- 12 deposits per workday: approximately $1,900+/month total



Your actual monthly pay depends on the number of deposits you close. The $1,900+ figure is not guaranteed. It reflects the approximate total for a top performer averaging about 12 deposits per workday.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call warm inbound leads generated through Astolia's Meta advertising

- Follow a proven sales script while sounding natural and human

- Ask the right questions to qualify each lead for a consultation

- Explain the offer clearly and handle objections with confidence

- Book qualified leads and close the $29 deposit

- Record every call, result, follow-up, and lead note accurately in our in-house CRM

- Work through your assigned call list every day

- Meet daily and weekly targets for calls, qualified leads, bookings, and deposits

- Join coaching sessions and apply feedback to improve your conversion rate

- Maintain a friendly, professional, and energetic tone on every call



FOR HUNGRY CLOSERS

This is not an entry-level customer-service role. It is for experienced phone sales professionals who can handle objections, stay disciplined, work to daily targets, and close. If you have measurable results in bookings, conversions, deposits, or quota attainment, we want to hear them.



REQUIREMENTS

- Clear, neutral, native-level or near-native spoken English suitable for phone conversations with US customers

- A neutral or minimal accent that is easy for US customers to understand

- Proven phone sales experience with measurable results such as bookings, conversions, deposits, or quota attainment

- Comfortable making calls for most of an eight-hour shift

- Able to follow a script without sounding robotic

description:
I run a used car buying and selling business in Australia and I'm growing my

This is ongoing work, not a one-off project. I'm looking for someone I can

work with long term, who learns my style and gets faster over time.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Silence cuts and filler word removal

- Frame changes and cuts to hold attention and improve retention

- Caption overlay

- Music overlay

- Screenshot and image inserts

- B-roll placement

- Managing social media posting

- Thumbnail creation and management



This is NOT heavy motion graphics work. No After Effects wizardry required.

What I need is an eye and an ear for pacing — knowing what holds a Western

audience's attention and what makes them scroll away.



THE STYLE I'M AFTER

Study these accounts before applying:

- Vookum

- Moving Merch

- MosesTheJeweler

- AutoLuxe

- Jerry Sells

- The Saliba Show

- George J Saliba



My current content is 
 on Instagram and TikTok. My delivery

is deadpan and dry — flat, understated, no hype. Important: the pauses are

often the joke. Do not cut every silence. I need someone who can tell the

difference between dead air and comic timing.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- Proven short form editing experience (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

- Strong English comprehension — you need to understand Australian speech

and humour to cut it properly

- Reliable computer and internet capable of handling large video files

- Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or equivalent

- Consistent turnaround. Reliability matters more to me than flair.



PAY & PROGRESSION

Starting at 10 hours per week — US$420/month, paid fortnightly via Wise

unless agreed otherwise.



This role is designed to grow. My intention is to move the right person to

full time within 3 months, at US$1,400–1,600/month. I'm not looking for a

freelancer to fill a gap. I'm looking for the person who runs my content

production long term.



Test edit before any commitment.



HOW TO APPLY

Send me:

1. Links to short form videos you have edited (your own cuts only)

3. Answer this question: pick ONE of the accounts listed above and tell me

in 2-3 sentences what that editor does that actually holds attention.

All applicants must state the amount of years experience they have and the engagement of their top performing reels and shorts.

not be reviewed.

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:

Amazon PPC Manager





We are seeking a highly analytical, performance-driven Amazon PPC Manager to lead and scale our advertising channels on Amazon. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing end-to-end paid search and display advertising campaigns across our brand catalog.



The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Amazon Advertising platforms (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP), a data-first mindset, and a proven track record of managing significant advertising budgets while maintaining target ACoS, TACoS, and ROAS parameters.



________________________________________

Key Responsibilities



Campaign Strategy & Execution

• Design, launch, and manage high-performing Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands (Video/Store Spotlight), and Sponsored Display campaigns.

• Structure and execute full-funnel advertising strategies targeting both intent-based shoppers and brand awareness segments.

• Plan and manage budget allocation across evergreen campaigns, seasonal pushes, and new product launches (NPL).

Keyword & Bidding Optimization

• Perform continuous keyword research, harvesting, indexing, and negative keyword filtering to eliminate inefficient ad spend.

• Execute day-to-day bid adjustments based on conversion rates, placement performance (Top of Search vs. Product Pages), and dayparting data.

• Leverage automated bidding tools and algorithmic strategies alongside manual controls to ensure optimal return.

Data Analytics & Reporting

• Monitor key performance indicators daily, including ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, Ad Spend, and Total Revenue.

• Analyze campaign impact on organic keyword rank and overall market share (Share of Voice).

• Produce weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights and executive summaries for leadership.

Inventory & Listing Alignment

• Collaborate with Content and SEO teams to align ad targets with listing optimizations (titles, bullet points, backend keywords).

• Partner with Supply Chain/Inventory teams to dynamically adjust ad spend based on stock levels, lead times, and sell-through velocity.

Market Intelligence & Innovation

• Stay ahead of Amazon Advertising updates, beta programs, algorithmic shifts, and industry best practices.

• Perform competitive analyses to identify market share opportunities, defense strategies, and emerging target keywords.



________________________________________

Qualifications & Requirements

• Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon PPC campaigns with a proven portfolio of driving sustainable brand growth.

• Budget Management: Demonstrated experience managing monthly ad spend

• Software & Tools Proficiency:

o Expert knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Advertising Console.

o Experience with Amazon analytics tools (e.g., Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, or Brand Analytics).

o Familiarity with third-party automation tools (e.g., Perpetua, Pacvue, BidX, or Prestozon).

Proven track record of prompt engineering or leveraging generative AI for PPC ad copy creation, keyword expansion, and search query analysis.

• Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to interpret raw sales/ad data and convert numbers into strategic action plans.

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional alignment and reporting.





To Apply:

Briefly discuss your hands-on experience with AI-powered PPC automation platforms.

Include a link to your profile or portfolio.

Number 90 is a vibrant canal-side bar, restaurant and events venue with two nightclub and event spaces. From corporate summer parties and Christmas celebrations to conferences, product launches, private dinners and large-scale events, no two enquiries are quite the same.

* Identifying opportunities to upsell additional event experiences

* Bringing your own ideas for generating leads and growing the business



**Confidence on the phone is essential.** We’re looking for someone who is genuinely comfortable speaking to new people, starting conversations and building relationships. If you enjoy sales and get satisfaction from turning a cold lead into a real opportunity, you’ll enjoy this role.



Who we're looking for



You’ll be a great fit if you are:



* Highly organised and reliable

* Confident, friendly and professional

* An excellent written and verbal English communicator

* Comfortable making outbound calls

* Commercially minded and motivated by results

* Comfortable working independently

* Curious and willing to research companies, industries and opportunities

* Keen to contribute ideas rather than simply complete tasks

* Looking for a stable, long-term role where you can grow with the company



Previous experience in **sales, lead generation, hospitality, events, customer service or business development** would be a strong advantage.



Working hours



This is a **full-time position, 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday**.



Your working day will run through to 4:00 PM UK time, so please consider the corresponding Philippine working hours carefully before applying. We are looking for someone who can commit to this schedule consistently and long-term.



 Why join us?



We want this person to become a genuine member of our team, not simply someone completing tasks remotely.



We already work with four team members based in the Philippines, several of whom have been with us for more than two years. We value people who are dependable, ambitious, committed and willing to take ownership of their work.

You'll unlock our bonus scheme.

You'll also earn an additional fee for **events you personally generate through your own sales activity**, including cold calling and prospecting. The amount depends on the value of the event, but a strong booking can be worth **$100+ in additional earnings**.



The more opportunities you create, the greater your potential to earn.

title: Business Development Manager — Outbound (B2B Photography)
description:
Read this part first



There is no pipeline. There are no inbound leads. There is no B2B team.



There's a company that quietly delivers photoshoots in 75 cities, has 250+ vetted photographers on the ground, turns edited work around in 24 hours, and has completed over 30,000 shoots — and has never once picked up the phone to a business.



That's the job. You'd be the first person to try.



If that sentence made you nervous, this isn't for you. If it made you sit up, keep reading.



Why this is a genuinely good patch



We can do something almost nobody else can. A brand needs the same shoot in twelve cities, to one brief, with one invoice. A hotel group wants guest photography across its European properties. A conference organiser needs coverage in Lisbon in March and Singapore in June. Most photography suppliers can serve one city. We serve seventy-five. That's your whole opening line, and it's true.



The product sells itself once it's in front of someone. It's photographs. You don't explain it, you show it.



Nothing is taken. No inherited accounts, no territory politics, no rep who "owns" that logo. Every deal you close is the first of its kind here, and everyone will know it was yours.



You'll talk to the person who d
. You'd be reporting to the GM and co-founder. No six-week approval chains, no committee between you and a yes.



What you'd actually do



Work defined verticals — exhibitions and trade shows, events, real estate and property, corporate and brand — across geographies we'll agree with you up front

Build and work lists. We'll give you a starting list; you'll grow it.

Prospect properly: LinkedIn,
, phone, events, whatever gets a conversation started

Run your own discovery calls, shape the offer, negotiate, close

Feed back what you're hearing — which verticals bite, which cities land, what pricing meets resistance. You're not just selling the thing, you're finding out what the thing should be.

Build the playbook as you go, so the second and third hire inherit something



Who this is for



You've done real outbound. You've built a territory from nothing and you can describe exactly how.

You know the difference between hunting and farming, and hunting is what you actually enjoy

You're comfortable being told "no" fifty times before a "yes", and you keep going because you know the maths

You write well. Most of your first impressions will be in writing.

You can hold a commercial conversation with a marketing director, an event producer or an estate agency owner without needing a script



Experience selling photography, creative services, events or travel is a real plus. If you've worked at Snappr, Flytographer, Splento or similar, we'd very much like to talk to you.



Who this isn't for



Anyone who needs leads handed to them, a manager checking in daily, or a market that already exists. This is the ground floor, and the ground floor is hard.



What you get



₱60,000 base per month, paid monthly, full-time and long-term.



Uncapped commission on everything you close at 6% of contract price. 



If this works, you won't stay a team of one. The person who proves this market will be the one who builds and runs the team that follows.



To apply



Don't send a generic CV. Send us:



A territory you built from zero. What it was, what you did, what it was worth after twelve months.

A cold outreach message — no more than 150 words — that you'd actually send to the Head of Marketing at a European hotel group, selling them photography across their properties.

Your notice period and your expectations on commission.



We'll reply to every application that includes number 2. We won't read the ones that don't.

Construction or trade-industry experience is a strong plus.

Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. Objectives:

-Create, document, and maintain clear, accurate, and scalable SOPs for simple, intermediate, and advanced operational processes.

-Ensure SOPs remain current by proactively updating documentation based on process changes, system updates, and leadership direction.

-Coordinate with department leaders and subject matter experts to capture workflows accurately and translate them into user-friendly documentation.

-Write, organize, publish and manage SOPs within Trainual and other documentation or training platforms to ensure accessibility and consistency.

-Support company-wide process standardization to improve efficiency, accountability, and cross-team alignment.

-Identify gaps, redundancies, or inefficiencies in existing processes and recommend improvements.



Competencies:

-Strong process-thinking and analytical skills with the ability to break down complex workflows into clear, actionable steps and visual process flowcharts.

-Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a high level of clarity, structure, and attention to detail.

-Proven ability to write and update SOPs for both technical and non-technical audiences.

-Experience using Trainual or similar documentation, knowledge management, or LMS platforms.

-Ability to manage multiple documentation projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

-Strong collaboration skills to work cross-functionally with leadership, operations, and field teams.

-Training or onboarding experience is a plus, particularly in explaining processes to new team members.

Education and Experience:

-At least 2 years of experience in process documentation, SOP creation, operations support, or a related role.

-Experience with Trainual or similar documentation/training platforms is highly preferred.

-Construction, electrical, facilities, or field-operations experience is a plus.

Equipment Requirements:

title: Appointment Setter and Patient Coordinator
description:
Now Hiring: Virtual Appointment Setter & Patient Coordinator



Hartley Chiropractic Center — Clearwater & Seminole, Florida

Remote • Full-Time • $8 USD/hour + Commission

Monday–Friday • Eastern Time



Why This Role Exists

Hartley Chiropractic Center is a growing, family-centered chiropractic practice with two locations in Pinellas County, Florida, on the Gulf Coast between Tampa and Clearwater Beach. Our team helps patients of all ages improve their health naturally through corrective chiropractic care, prenatal and pediatric care, non-surgical spinal decompression, neuropathy care, functional medicine, and auto-a
 care.



Our in-office team is focused on creating an exceptional experience for the patients standing in front of them. We are hiring a confident, warm, and results-driven Virtual Appointment Setter & Patient Coordinator to take ownership of incoming leads, appointment setting, follow-up, and patient communication.



This is not simply an administrative position. You will be the first voice many prospective patients hear, and your ability to connect with them may be the reason they finally receive the help they need.



About Hartley Chiropractic Center

Hartley Chiropractic Center has served Pinellas County for more than 16 years. We are a second-generation, doctor-owned practice with an all-female chiropractic team serving patients from our Clearwater and Seminole offices.



Our mission is to help practice members reach their full health potential without the use of drugs or surgery, educate our community, and create generational health.



Our core values are:



* Commitment

* Excellence as a Standard

* Education

* High Energy

* Impact



We are known for taking on challenging cases and helping people who may have started to lose hope. We care deeply about our patients, but we also believe in accountability, measurable results, clear communication, and consistent follow-through.



The Role

As our Virtual Appointment Setter & Patient Coordinator, you will be responsible for helping prospective and existing patients take the next step in their care.



You will respond to incoming inquiries, answer calls, make outbound calls, schedule new patients, confirm appointments, recover cancellations, follow up with leads, and reconnect with former patients.



You will work closely with our Office Manager, doctors, in-office patient coordinators, and marketing team. You must be comfortable working independently while staying in constant communication with the team.



This is a long-term, full-time remote contractor position working during Hartley Chiropractic Center’s lead-response and operating hours in the Eastern Time Zone.



What You Will Do

Lead Response and Appointment Setting

* Respond to new leads within three minutes during assigned working hours.

* Manage leads received through our website, phone calls, online advertising, social media, referrals, community events, and other marketing campaigns.

* Answer incoming new-patient calls with warmth, professionalism, confidence, and urgency.

* Make outbound calls to prospective patients who have requested information.

* Learn how to explain our services and new-patient offers clearly and accurately.

* Ask thoughtful questions to understand what each prospective patient needs.

* Guide qualified callers toward scheduling their first appointment.

* Schedule appointments accurately in ChiroHD and verify all required information.

* Send appointment confirmations, forms, texts,
s, and reminders.

* Track every lead from the first contact through the scheduled appointment and completed new-patient visit.

* Make sure every lead receives consistent follow-up and does not quietly go cold.



Follow-Up and Patient Coordination

* Follow established call, text, and
 sequences for leads who do not schedule during the first conversation.

* Confirm upcoming new-patient appointments.

* Ask whether there is any reason the patient may be unable to attend.

* Follow up immediately with patients who miss or cancel an appointment.

* Recover cancellations and help patients reschedule.

* Contact former patients for reactivation and re-care opportunities.

* Work assigned call lists completely and on time.

* Help existing patients with scheduling questions and appointment coordination.

* Escalate clinical, billing, insurance, or sensitive patient questions to the appropriate team member.

 

CRM and Record Management

* Document every call, text, appointment, follow-up attempt, and outcome.

* Maintain accurate patient and lead records in ChiroHD and our lead-management systems.

* Update lead statuses and next steps so the entire team can see where each person stands.

* Protect patient confidentiality and follow all HCC privacy and HIPAA policies.

* Use only assigned accounts and approved systems when accessing patient information.

* Never download or store patient information on a personal device.

* Maintain organized follow-up lists and complete assigned tasks by their deadlines.



Sales Communication

* Present our new-patient offers with confidence and clarity.



* Communicate the value of coming into the office without diagnosing, making guarantees, or giving clinical advice.



* Respond professionally to common objections, including:

  * “I need to think about it.”

  * “I need to speak with my spouse.”

  * “I will call you back.”

  * “I need to check my schedule.”

  * “How much will this cost?”

  * “Do you accept my insurance?”



You must be able to adjust your communication style for parents, pregnant women, active adults, patients in chronic pain, people with disc injuries, neuropathy patients, and auto-a
 patients.



You must help callers feel heard, understood, hopeful, and confident about scheduling.



Team Communication

* Communicate consistently with the HCC team through Slack and other approved systems.

* Acknowledge team messages promptly so the sender knows they were received.

* Attend scheduled virtual meetings, coaching sessions, and training.

* Submit an accurate end-of-day report.

* Report daily results, questions, problems, recurring objections, lead-quality concerns, and missed opportunities.

* Accept coaching professionally and apply feedback quickly.

* Contribute ideas that may improve lead response, patient communication, appointment conversions, and show rates.



Required Experience and Skills

* Excellent spoken and written English is required.

* A clear, warm, confident, and professional phone voice is required.

* Previous phone-sales or appointment-setting experience is required.

* Previous experience using a CRM or structured lead-management system is required.

* At least two years of experience in appointment setting, inside sales, customer service, lead follow-up, or another phone-based role is strongly preferred.

* Experience in chiropractic, dental, wellness, physical therapy, med-spa, or a related practice is a strong advantage.

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls when necessary.

* Able to move confidently between phone calls, text messages,
, Slack, ChiroHD, and a CRM.

* Fast and accurate typing.

* Strong attention to detail and reliable follow-through.

* Comfortable being measured by specific performance goals.

* Available to work the complete assigned HCC schedule in the Eastern Time Zone.

* Reliable high-speed internet, a dependable computer, a professional headset, and a private, quiet workspace are required.

* A backup plan for internet or power interruptions is strongly preferred.



Personal Qualities That Will Make You Successful

Warmth- Patients should be able to hear your smile. You can make someone feel genuinely cared for while still guiding the conversation toward a decision.



Confidence- You are comfortable asking for the appointment. You do not end every conversation with, “Just call us back when you are ready.”



Urgency-You understand that a delayed response can mean a lost patient. You take prompt action without making callers feel pressured.



Persistence-You can hear “not yet,” continue following the process, and remain positive and professional.



Ownership-You take responsibility for your leads, follow-up tasks, documentation, and results. You do not wait for someone to remind you about unfinished work.



Organization-You can manage multiple conversations and follow-up dates without losing important details or allowing leads to disappear.



Coachability-You welcome direct feedback, practice new scripts, and make corrections quickly.



Integrity-You handle private patient information responsibly, document conversations accurately, and speak honestly about your results.



Heart for Helping People-Many of our patients have lived with pain or declining health for years. You should genuinely care about helping them take the first step toward receiving care.



What Success Looks Like

During your first 90 days, we will train and evaluate you using the following performance measures:

* Average lead-response time

* Percentage of new leads contacted within three minutes

* Contact rate

* Lead-to-appointment conversion rate

* New-patient show rate

* Number of qualified new patients who complete their appointments

* Outbound call volume

* Completion of assigned follow-up tasks

* Cancellation and missed-appointment recovery

* Reactivation appointments scheduled

* Accuracy and completeness of CRM and ChiroHD documentation

* Reliability, attendance, communication, and responsiveness

* Quality of patient conversations

* Compliance with HCC procedures and privacy requirements



The goal is not simply to make a large number of calls. The goal is to create quality conversations that result in qualified patients scheduling and keeping their appointments.



Compensation

* Base pay: $8 USD per hour**

* Commission:** Earned in addition to base pay and tied directly to booked and showed new-patient appointments. The stronger your performance, the more you can earn—THERE IS NO COMMISSION CAP. The complete commission structure will be reviewed and confirmed during the interview.

* Full-time schedule

* Paid training on HCC’s services, systems, scripts, offers, and patient-communication standards

* Performance and compensation review after the successful completion of the first 90 days

* Opportunity for increased responsibility and advancement as the practice grows



Schedule

* Monday–Thursday: 8:00 AM–6:30 PM Eastern Time

* Friday: 8:00 AM–2:00 PM Eastern Time

* Full-time availability during the complete assigned schedule is required.

* Dependable attendance and prompt responsiveness throughout working hours are essential.



What You Can Expect From Us

* Consistent full-time work with an established and growing healthcare practice

* Base pay plus uncapped commission

* Clear expectations and measurable goals

* Paid training on our systems, scripts, services, offers, and patient-communication standards

* Structured coaching and feedback

* Support from an experienced Office Manager, doctors, and patient-care team

* The opportunity to become a meaningful part of the HCC team

* A workplace that values commitment, excellence, education, high energy, and impact

* The satisfaction of helping people take an important first step toward improving their health

* Opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement as our practice grows



How to Apply

If you have read this posting and know you would be excellent in this role, we want to hear from you.

Please submit the following:

1. Your resume in English.

2. A short cover message in English explaining why you are the right person for this role.

3. A brief video recording telling us about yourself and your work experience. At the end of your video, include a short demonstration in English. Imagine you are answering a call from a new patient at Hartley Chiropractic Center. Greet the caller warmly, introduce yourself, and let the caller know you would love to help them book their first appointment.

4. A one-sentence answer to this question:



   “What is one thing you did in a previous role that made a real difference for the business?”



Application Filter

Please include the phrase **“I read the whole posting”** at the top of your cover message. This helps us know that you read the posting carefully and can follow instructions.



Applications that do not include the required video recording or the phrase **“I read the whole posting”** will not be reviewed.



Timeline

We are moving quickly to fill this role. Top candidates will be contacted for a video interview within five business days.



We hope to have our new team member fully onboarded within three to four weeks. This is a long-term, full-time position for someone who wants to grow with Hartley Chiropractic Center.



We are excited to meet you.



Dr. Theresa Hartley, Owner

Hartley Chiropractic Center

Clearwater & Seminole, Florida

description:

We’re looking for an experienced Graphic Designer / Artworker to support our promotional merchandise business on a freelance, remote basis.



The role is mainly about taking customer logos, brand guidelines and artwork and turning them into accurate, print-ready artwork for promotional products.



You’ll be working on products such as bags, bottles, notebooks, pens, clothing, mugs and other branded merchandise.

Prepare print-ready artwork using Adobe Illustrator

Work accurately with customer brand identity guidelines

Check logos, colours, fonts and positioning

Apply customer artwork to promotional product templates

Create clear artwork visuals/proofs showing how the finished product will look

Set artwork to the correct print area and dimensions

Experience working with promotional merchandise, branded clothing, print, signage or packaging would be a big advantage.



We’re a friendly team and would ideally like to find someone we can build a long-term working relationship with as our artwork requirements grow.



When applying, please send us some examples of print-ready artwork or branded merchandise artwork you have previously produced and let us know your experience with Adobe Illustrator.

description:
Executive Assistant & Client Services Remote Specialist 

Part-Time | Senior Tier | 10am–2pm BST (5pm–9pm PHT)



**About the Business

We are a London-based personal styling and style strategy business founded by an author and certified stylist with over 20 years of experience. She works with high-achieving professional women on a 1:1 basis and runs a membership community for women who want to dress with intention and confidence.



The team is small and close-knit. Everyone pulls their weight and takes ownership of their area. The business is growing, and this hire is a key part of making that growth sustainable.



**The Team

-The Founder and Lead Stylist

-The Head of Operations (systems, strategy, data, marketing)

-The Community Manager (member engagement in the Hub)

-The new hire - this role



**Overview

This is a combined Executive Assistant and Client Services role. The two halves sit together naturally: the EA side keeps the Founder organised, protected, and able to focus on her work, while the client services side ensures that every person enquiring about working with the founder 1:1 is handled with the same level of care and professionalism that her high-ticket service demands.



The Founder’s 1:1 clients are high-earning professionals investing £4,500 to £7,800 in a styling service. Every touchpoint needs to feel considered, personal, and reflective of the quality of the work.

The longer-term ambition is for this person to grow into a trusted EA who can respond on The Founder’s behalf, gatekeep her time, and operate with a high degree of autonomy. That level of trust takes time to build — but it is the goal, and we are looking for someone who is genuinely excited by that prospect.



The role reports to both the Founder and the Head of Operations, with the Head of Operations leading on onboarding, systems setup, and day-to-day operational guidance.



**Key Responsibilities

-Executive Assistance & Diary Management

-This is the most personal and most important part of the role. The Founder, with ADHD, is intentionally building a more structured, protected working week. This person will be instrumental in making that possible.

-Full management of the Founder’s and the company’s 
 email accounts

-Triaging all incoming emails: filing, disposing, actioning, or escalating as appropriate.

-Proactive diary management: identifying availability, updating Calendly, scheduling calls, and protecting the Founder’s time without being asked.

-Keeping the Founder's working week running to her four-day schedule.

-Flagging anything time-sensitive before it becomes a problem.

-Supporting the Founder to keep her commitments to herself and her working rhythms.



*1:1 Client Services

-This person will own the entire client journey from first enquiry to session completion, handling every touchpoint in a warm, professional tone that reflects the quality of the service.

-Identifying new client enquiries and sending the correct initial response with service PDF and booking link.

-Managing the discovery call booking process in Calendly.

-Following up post-call when a client d
 to proceed.

-Sending the client questionnaire and preparation assignment at the right 
nt.

-Chasing deposit payments and confirming receipt.

-Keeping the Notion CRM accurate and up to date throughout.

-Handling all client communication in a warm, professional tone that reflects the quality of the service.



*Financial & Bookkeeping Admin

-Forwarding receipts and invoices to Dext (our accountancy software).

-Liaising with the bookkeeper to locate missing VAT receipts and invoices.



*Content Scheduling

-Content is created by the team. This role is responsible for getting it live accurately and on time.

-Scheduling social media content on Instagram.

-Scheduling LinkedIn articles and posts.

-Scheduling email newsletters via Flodesk.



*Asset Management

-Uploading and downloading files, videos, and course content across Google Drive, 
, and Vimeo.

-Keeping digital assets organised and easy to locate.

-A reliable internet connection capable of handling large video file uploads and downloads is a practical requirement.

-Community Membership Management (from Month 2)

-Processing membership cancellations and offboarding via Stripe.

-Keeping the member list current: additions, removals, and status updates.

-Managing membership payments and flagging any issues promptly.

-Updating client records in Notion and Airtable.

-Collecting and reporting backend data: subscription stats, cancellation rates, and other key metrics on a regular rhythm.



*Phased Timeline



Month 1 - EA Support & 1:1 Client Services Gmail inbox management, new enquiry flow, post-call client journey, diary management, Notion CRM updates, receipt and invoice forwarding to Dext, social media and newsletter scheduling, asset uploads and downloads.



Months 2/3 - Elevate Membership Management Added Stripe payments, cancellations, and offboarding; member list maintenance; Airtable CRM alongside Notion; backend reporting and subscription data.



**Systems & Software

Full training will be provided on our specific workflows. The candidate should be comfortable picking up new tools quickly. The core stack is:



-Claude (AI assistant - used across the business for drafting, comms, and system support)

-Calendly (meeting scheduler)

-Slack (team communication)

-Google Workspace - Gmail, Drive, Calendar

-Notion - client and booking management (from day one)

-Airtable - client records (Month 2 onwards)

-Stripe - membership payments and cancellations (Month 2 onwards)

-Flodesk - email newsletter scheduling

-Dext - receipt and invoice management


 - Video asset platform

-Vimeo - video asset management

-Instagram & LinkedIn - content scheduling



**Role Requirements

-At least 5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, VA, or in a senior client services role.

-Experience supporting founders or senior executives - ideally in a small business or premium service environment.

-Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities independently.

-Excellent written and spoken English with a warm, professional, and polished communication style.

-Highly proactive - able to anticipate needs and solve problems with minimal supervision.

-Confident handling high-value, discerning clients with maturity and discretion.

-A deep, intuitive understanding of the wardrobe challenges, lifestyle rhythms, and styling needs of high-achieving professional women.

-Comfortable with numbers, data, and reporting (from Month 2 onwards).

-A reliable, high-speed internet connection capable of handling large video file transfers.

-Highly Desirable

-Expertise in Google Workspace management - especially Gmail 

-Experience with Claude (Anthropic's AI assistant) for drafting, system integration, and workflow automation.

-Familiarity with Notion, Airtable, Stripe, Flodesk, Dext, or 
.

-Background in luxury, lifestyle, fashion, or other premium service industries.

-Experience implementing or improving CRM systems and SOPs.



**Personal Attributes

-Skills and experience are important, but character is what matters most for this role. We are looking for someone who genuinely wants to be part of a growing business and take pride in the work they do.

title: Cold Email Infrastructure & Deliverability Lead | Tenants, Inboxes, LinkedIn/Aimfox | Finance
description:
Cold
 Infrastructure & Deliverability Lead |
 + LinkedIn | $1,000 - $1,500/mo



Full-time | Fully remote | Long-term role | Room to grow into owning GTM



We are a capital advisory firm (investment banking: we help companies raise equity and debt) with a 25+ person international team. Cold
 and LinkedIn are the entire top of our funnel.



We are hiring ONE person to own that infrastructure end to end. Not campaigns only. Not copy only. The machine itself: domains, tenants, inboxes, deliverability, data, and the LinkedIn estate that runs beside it.



The target is not a vanity number. We are building toward 1,000,000
s sent per DAY through our own tenants and inboxes, landing in the inbox, at reply rates that hold. If that number makes you excited rather than nervous, keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Sending infrastructure end to end: domains (bulk buying, registrars, DNS), tenants, inboxes, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, MX, warmup, ramp schedules, daily caps, rotation and splits

- Buying inboxes at volume. You know which providers are worth it right now, what a fair price per inbox is, which ones resell recycled tenants, and which ones will get you banned. We use ScaledMail today. You should be able to name three alternatives you would evaluate this month and why

- Microsoft 365 / Azure / Entra ID at scale: tenant creation and management, licensing, per-tenant reputation, what actually triggers a Microsoft ban, and how to send via tenant properly. Same for Google Workspace, including where each one breaks and which to use for what

- Deliverability as a daily discipline: inbox placement testing, seed lists, blacklist monitoring and delisting (SURBL, Spamhaus, UCEPROTECT), spam triggers, link and content hygiene, bounce and complaint handling, and reputation recovery when a domain or tenant goes bad

- Data: cheap, high quality lead sourcing (we expect Apollo tier economics, around $13 per 10,000 contacts), dedupe, enrichment, and a verification stack that holds bounce rates down. You know which verification tools are actually accurate and what they cost per 1,000

- LinkedIn infrastructure on Aimfox: accounts, limits, sessions, campaign setup, sequences, and keeping the whole estate healthy and logged in

- Retargeting: running retargeting campaigns off our outbound audiences so prospects see us more than once

- Replies: you handle the inbound. Triage, respond, route the good ones to our setters. A reply that sits for a day is a dead lead

- The numbers: sends, deliveries, bounces, replies, positive replies, meetings booked. Per campaign, per domain, per inbox, per tenant. You report what matters and nothing else



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW

- That tracking stays OFF. No open pixels, no link tracking, ever. And you can explain what you measure instead

- How to split volume across inboxes, domains and tenants without cooking reputation

- The difference between a hard bounce on a dead address and a provider throttling or blocking you, from the bounce string alone

- What to do in the first hour when a sending domain hits SURBL or placement falls off a cliff

- How long a new domain warms before it carries real volume, and what a sane ramp looks like

- Why a sending domain should never route back to the main brand domain

- How to keep suppression and opt-out handling clean, because that is deliverability too



WHO WE WANT

Someone genuinely obsessed with this game. You follow the space, you have broken things at scale and fixed them, and you have real opinions about infrastructure providers. You take initiative. Nobody here will hand you a daily task list. You see a bottleneck, you fix it. You have an idea, you test it and show us the numbers.



This is a seat with real room. Infrastructure first, then the full outbound motion, then a team under you. We want someone who wants to grow into owning GTM for the firm and stay for years.



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

- Your cold
 experience is a few hundred sends from one Gmail account

- You have never bought domains in bulk or stood up a tenant

- You think warmup and deliverability are optional details

- You want to run this alongside five other clients. This is a full-time, dedicated seat



COMPENSATION

- $1,000 - $1,500 USD per month, depending on what you actually know. Show us the top of that range and we will pay it

- Full-time, long term. We are hiring for years, not for a project

- You work directly with the founder



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word TENANT so we know you read this. Then answer these, short and specific:

1. The largest sending operation you have personally run:
s per day, number of inboxes, number of domains, and reply rate.

2. Where do you buy inboxes and domains, and what do you pay per inbox?

3. You need 500 new sending inboxes live on Microsoft this month. Walk me through it: tenants, domains, DNS, warmup, and the ramp schedule you would use.

4. A sending domain just hit SURBL and placement dropped. What are your first three moves?

5. What is your
 verification stack, and what bounce rate do you hold?

6. Which tools have you actually run? (Smartlead, Instantly,
Bison, Aimfox, HeyReach, Apollo, Clay, etc.)



Answer in your own words. Pasted AI output is obvious and gets deleted. A short Loom walking through infrastructure you have built is a big plus. Applications that ignore the instructions above are deleted unread.

title: Dental Sleep Medicine Virtual Assistant – Insurance & Authorization Specialist
description:
Black Rose Practice Management (BRPM) is a growing U.S.-based practice management company specializing in Dental Sleep Medicine (DSM). We partner with dental practices to help manage the medical insurance side of treating patients with obstructive sleep apnea and oral appliance therapy.



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to join our team with a primary focus on insurance verification, prior authorizations, and GAP management.



We are a small, growing company, and we are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted part of the team, take ownership of their responsibilities, and grow with us.



For the right person, there is significant opportunity to increase hours, compensation, and responsibility over time.



Your Primary Responsibilities

Your day-to-day work will primarily include:

• Verification of Benefits (VOB) for Dental Sleep Medicine patients

• Prior Authorization (PA) requests and follow-up

• GAP/network exception requests

• Reviewing medical insurance benefits and plan requirements

• Working with payer portals and contacting U.S. insurance companies

• Tracking pending requests and completing appropriate follow-up

• Accurately documenting benefits, reference numbers, authorization requirements, and payer responses

• Following individual client-specific workflows and guidelines

• Managing incoming requests and keeping work organized and current

• Identifying when information doesn't make sense or requires additional research rather than simply checking a box

Because the information we provide directly affects our clients and their patients, accuracy is non-negotiable.



We would especially love to hear from candidates who have experience (but not required) with:

• Oral Appliance Therapy (OAT)

• Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA)

• E0486

• DME benefits and requirements

• Medical billing within a dental practice

• Medical insurance verification for sleep appliances

• Prior authorization for oral appliance therapy

• Medicare/DME

• GAP or network exception requests

• DentalWriter or similar DSM software

• Credentialing or payer enrollment

What We're Looking For

You may be a great fit if you:

• Have exceptional attention to detail

• Are highly proficient in written and reading English

• Can confidently read and interpret insurance benefit information

• Can follow different instructions for multiple clients without mixing up their workflows

• Are comfortable calling U.S. insurance companies and navigating payer portals

• Are highly comfortable with web-based software and online tools

• Have intermediate Excel skills

• Can manage multiple open requests, deadlines, and follow-ups

• Are organized without needing someone to constantly remind you what comes next

• Can adapt when priorities change

• Ask questions when something doesn't make sense instead of guessing

• Take ownership of your work and follow a request through to completion

• Are interested in learning—not just completing assigned tasks

Some availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours is required for insurance calls and payer follow-up

Opportunity for increased hours, compensation, and responsibilities as the company grows



Where This Role Can Go



BRPM is growing, and this position can grow with it.



Initially, we need someone who can become exceptionally good at managing VOBs, PAs, GAPs, and insurance follow-up.



Once you've mastered that work, there may be opportunities to expand into areas such as:

• Provider credentialing

• Medical billing support

• Claims follow-up

• Client account management

• Training and quality assurance

• Workflow development

• Team leadership

• Practice management operations

We're looking for someone who wants to understand why we do what we do, notices when something could be done better, and wants to help build the systems as we grow.



We're not looking for someone who simply wants to clock in and clock out.



We're looking for someone who wants to become part of what we're building.



For the right person, the sky really is the limit.
